Seems more like they are looking for tips verses being genuinely nice.  3 more days of this... I'm afraid it's not going to get any better.   To be continued .. but I'm not just unimpressed.. I'm pretty upset.

findings.title: A R. (2/5)
findings.snippet: They keep getting worse. 3 years ago they were really good and now, they closed half of the restaurants for renovations and didn't inform the guests, food variety is poor. Customer service is EXTREMELY bad! We arrived at 7am, I formed the reception, were told to wait. We came again at 10am and we told that our room will be on the 3rd floor, and, as newlyweds we will receive some kind of a gift. Came again at 4pm to check in and they didn't have a room for us.... can you imagine?! The system was SO bad, they forgot about us and gave our room to someone else! They ended up giving us a ground floor suit with the view of a parking lot... I immediately went to complain and got a very rude answer "well your room is more expensive than what you paid". Receptionist was clearly unhappy when I stated that I paid for the view and not for the size, then she said that hotel is full and we have to stay in that room.... horrible! We got a new room with the view (what I paid for!!) on the next day. The new room is next to an elevator and the entry door is... well, let's say it has holes big enough to disturb privacy. Not even starting on the noise-proof "features". We can hear every sound from the hall. They turn on music inside the hotel very loudly up until 11-12am. If you want sleep- bring earplugs. So far, we had a horrible experience. Can't wait to check out and never come back.

findings.title: Ashanti L. (1/5)
findings.snippet: Nice interior decorations at this hotel but wouldn't recommend it for several valid reasons. 1. Air conditioner in rooms is set, if you're hot, the AC only goes down to a set number and the room is still warm. 2. There's no cool air in the entire hotel. So you sweat outside in 95 degree weather and come into resort/ sauna.  3. Food sucks all over this site. The food is way below average. We were hungry the entire weekend. 4. Pool is very cold. Barely saw anyone in them. 5. Three restaurants were closed for remodeling. You won't find out until you arrive. 6. The hotel is a maze, multiple stairs all over the place that makes it exhausting. If you want to relax and eat well don't pick this place. 7. Not kid friendly.

findings.title: Roberto R. (3/5)
findings.snippet:
This is not the best resort in Cancun but it does the trick. Staff are very nice always saying hello, rooms have a hot tub, Club Melia.
Beach is beautiful and the sea is so calm, you can swim safely with the kids.
There are barely any solicitors so you can really relax.

findings.title: Nicole K. (3/5)
findings.snippet:
This is a very beautiful property. The staff was super nice and friendly. Food was okay. NAOS the buffet was surprisingly the best place to eat. All the other places that required reservations were just okay. Ambiance is amazing. When you walk in it smells like flowers and someone is always asking you if you would like something to drink. The rooms are nice. We had to switch rooms though when we first arrived because of ants. I will say that the first room was a lot nicer than the second room that we ended up in. Didn't have as many upgrades. View was just as beautiful though. We had a Royal Service package which included room service for free 24 hours, access to the spa from 9-9 and a stocked bar, premium liquor and access to the adult only portion of the resort with an exclusive restaurant. All very very nice. 

My deduction of stars comes from the overly aggressive sales staff. We had to have denied at least 10 people in the last 2 days. We sat through a presentation which we NEVER ever do but decided to because we were asked so many times. It was 2 hours although they said it would be 90 mins. After we declined. The sales associate called her boss over to give us a better deal. I declined and the manager stood up and said "well I can't help you" and stormed off. Almost like a car buying experience. Wayyyy too aggressive. I actually would have thought about it if it wasn't for the managers disposition. 

All in all this was an okay stay. If you come just stay away from the sales staff and look out for the ants.

findings.title: Rocio C. (1/5)
findings.snippet: If I could give it a negative star I would . I came in the hotel to use the ATM and the bell man and other. Co worker approached me and said that the ATM's are for use of hotel guest only. If I would have wanted to of stayed at the hotel I would have walked away with just the unwelcoming experience I had. I've been in other hotels in Cancun to use the ATM machine and it hasn't been an issue. I'm so glad I choose to stay at a different hotel while in my stay. And wish any future guest good luck in there stay there .

findings.title: Katherine T. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
The WORST vacation experience of my life! My husband and I have always loved Cancun and have basically come to Cancun for every major vacation. We went to Riu Caribe in 2010 for our very 1st vacation together, then again to Riu Cancun later on, then in 2013 to Riu Caribe again and then Riu Penninsula, the newest one, in 2014 for our honeymoon, and again in 2016 when we found out I was pregnant with our daughter. Needless to say, we LOVE our Riu chain because it guarantees us the same level of quality service wherever and whenever we go. This time around, everyone we knew recommended this hotel and since we were bringing our 20 month old daughter and my parents with us, they wanted to try something new, which brought us here. BIG MISTAKE. HUGE! 

First of all, we booked all-inclusive, not "semi-inclusive" and here they inform you if you want certain amenities, you have to pay more. So in essence, it's not all-inclusive. It's we lore you here and then you have no choice but to pay more if you want to have a good time. Otherwise, staff doesn't care if you love it or hate it. They just care about selling you their CLUB MELIA time shares. When we booked, they promised us a free couples massage. When we arrived, in order to get it, we had to sit through a 90 minute time share presentation to get it. They're much more focused on their time share selling than anything else and they're not even good deals. Even if I was in the market for a timeshare, I'd recognize it's not a good deal.

Upon arrival, we discovered the lobby has no A/C at all which coupled with heat and humidity is a constant recipe for disaster. Basically, any time my husband steps out of any restaurant or room with a/c, by the time we get to any other location he is drenched in sweat. I don't even sweat that much normally and I find myself covered in it. Yes, I must admit the lobby is beautiful...but beauty over comfort? Nope! Not when humidity is so unbearable that sunblock literally leaks off before you get to the pool. 

It gets "better." The room they put us in had an a/c that barely worked. We were waking up in a puddle of sweat each morning. We told the front desk about it. Think they cared? Nope! Usually the business of hospitality is hospitable...they must've missed that lesson. Only on the 3rd day did they move us to a different room. Not an easy task to re-pack 2 adults and a toddler, but in order to get another room and working a/c, the daunting task was worth it. Also, the room was so dirty that the sheets had stains, the comforter was ripped & feathers were falling out of it, and the bathroom accommodations were so dirty that I had to resort to washing myself and the baby with washcloths in the sink to avoid getting into that awful shower. It was only when we got relocated that I was able to bathe us both and finally feel like things were looking up for a split second.

Food and entertainment are the reasons everyone recommended this resort. Well okay, specialty restaurants must be reserved the day before and they are pretty good...but your other meals are the buffet, which is beyond terrible and has no variety. Literally same horrible food day in and day out. In comparison with our beloved Riu chain, you can't even compare it. Their buffet has an abundance of food, a different themed night every day, and great options for every meal. Their specialty restaurants are not as amazing but in the grand scheme of things, I'd rather have average specialty restaurants and normal meals and variety of choices for all other meals. Entertainment? What entertainment? There's a schedule for entertainment. They have an app that tells you when things are happening. We've been here almost a week and I have yet to see a single activity take place. Their shows are set up around the pool in the heat and humidity and they're average at best for shows I've seen at Riu or really any other resort I've stayed at my entire life. My parents are also not impressed and they felt the Riu wasn't up to their standards before this trip. Now we all wish we stayed there or didn't go on vacation at all. 

Beach? I guess I can't fault the hotel for the seaweed brought on by global warming and the fact that there are small waves, but getting into brown colored wave, seaweed infused water doesn't really scream paradise to me. So you'd think the pool would be pleasant as an alternative. I guess when you assume things, you know what it leads to...pool water is too warm, no activities going on, and little shade to hide from the blazing sun. 

In summary, the main things people usually go on vacation to a paradise style resort for - beach, relaxation, fun, and an enjoyable experience - do not exist here. What does exist here is an old, dirty resort with staff that don't care to help you or correct any issues you have coupled with terrible dining and entertainment resulting in utter boredom. Do NOT come here for your vacation. We cut our trip to get out of here asap.

findings.title: Stan S. (1/5)
findings.snippet: We started off waiting for an extended period of time after our check-in time because the room was not ready. When we finally arrived to the room some of the pillowcases and sheets were dirty and clearly have not been changed. We informed housekeeping on the floor had them change out the soiled linens. We had a mini fridge in the room. I opened it to get a bottle of water and it was warm. The fridge was plugged in, but not working. We called the front desk to notify and they said someone would be up in a few minutes. The maintenance man did not come until about 3 hours later. I called to make a reservation at a restaurant for the following day. Only one place had availability to make a reservation. When we arrived there the hostess could not find my name on the list. It took some convincing and we were finally seated. The whole hotel has NO air conditioning in the atrium or hallways. The restaurant was in the center of the hotel and everyone was hot and uncomfortable. We were literally sweating and did not even feel comfortable to eat. The next morning I was woken up to a sound of dripping water. I investigated the sound and found water to be dripping from the bathroom ceiling. I called the front desk. I was shocked that they sent someone up and they were unable to fix it and did not move our room. I asked the manager to please relocate us since the floor was very slippery and my girlfriend already fell. I feel this property has potential, but the management is terrible and leaves their customers unsatisfied. I cannot believe the property does not even have air conditioning in the common areas. I would  not return to this hotel again. Very disappointed. When we left we reported and even took pictures of our concerns, and not even an apology was received. As a corporate travel agent who has many clients travel to the area, I will not be recommending your property in the near future. I had hoped very much to have a pleasurable experience and was very let down.

findings.title: Jeff B. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
ROYAL SERVICE REVIEW 
Day 1 arrival day! I recommend using USA TRANSFERS they were easy to find and friendly, they got us to the resort w/o any issues and told us about the culture of the area. 

Check in,  we were greeted by the staff who took our luggage and walked us inside where we were met by another staff who took our name and seated us while they went to get the royal service staff. After 5 minutes we were escorted to the royal service area and met with a drink. They explained the hotel and services and that our butler would be meeting with us shortly. We met our butler (Daniel) who explained his role and since our room was not ready he took us to LaPalapa, an exclusive royal service restaurant. The food was wonderful, we had a great lunch and Daniel took us to a Bali bed while our room was being ready. At 1500 hrs he texted us to say the room was ready, he gave us the tour of our wonderful room. The rest of the day was spent using the pool and pool bar for drinks. We had dinner at Vento which is a tapas restaurant. The food was great, the service even better.

Day 2,

We started off with the breakfast area for royal service  guest, fruit, cereals,eggs, pastries, everything was good. We had a Bali bed by the pool so we spend the entire day there. We had Ramon serve us water and drinks all day. We ordered lunch around 1 and had wings, nachos, spring rolls. Everything was so good. The downside to the day was it rained, for 5 mins lol!! 
Dinner was at Bana, it is Asian and we didn't want a lot of food so we ordered crab salads and each of us got sushi rolls. OMG, this sushi was to die for, so fresh and so yummy we thought about ordering more but they brought us dessert and we had 
enough. We would eat at Bana's again and again.

Day3
We had a 10 am spa treatment and arrived at 9 as suggested, the 45 minute hydro treatment was great, steam/shower/sauna/ hydro pool and then off to the couples massage. Very relaxing and needed. After the spa we went to see if our butler had gotten us a Bali bed and of course he did. We enjoyed the pool and bar service all day. Dinner was at Enso, which was yummy. My wife's only issue was the shrimp are prepared w the heads still on. But on there than that the food was tasty and flavorful.

Day 4, 

Another day in paradise, 
We did nothing special today even though it was our anniversary. We went to the pool and got our Bali bed and chilled, they brought our lunch and drinks all day, it rained for approx 5 minutes and that was it. Our butler had the room made up with roses and it was very nice of him. The dinner was at Feguo and our waiter, christen was great, he recommended food choices and we got 3 appetizers shrimp ceviche, grouper and shrimp bisque soup everything was so good. I got the steak and my wife the chicken which we both loved.  As we are nearing the end of the trip so far we rank the restaurants 
1, Bana
2 mole 
2 a Vento
2b fequo 
3 Enso

Our trip is ending and it was great. Now there are some downsides to the trip, the ocean experienced seaweed, something they can't control, there is no other complaints we used housekeeping to bring us shampoo and items and that was done in 5 minutes. If you want a relaxing resort choose royal service and stay here

findings.title: Ramon B. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Great resort. All inclusive literally means ALL inclusive.the staff is amazing and they treat you like royalty. Paradisus is a must if you plan to come to Mexico or any vacation at that!!!

findings.title: Kory M. (5/5)
findings.snippet: We had a fantastic stay! I've been to several all inclusive resorts in Mexico/the Caribbean I have to say this was by far the best resort I've visited. Everything was very clean and the staff does a great job making sure you are having a great time. The best part of our stay was the food. Usually all inclusive resorts serve average food but not Paradisus. Every night we had a fantastic dinner, our favorite was Mole! The pool was very nice, however offered little shade if you needed to escape the sun for a bit. We 10/10 would stay here again.

findings.title: Olivia C. (5/5)
findings.snippet: We just had a girls trip at the Paradisus for the weekend. We had the absolute best service from Joel Dejesos-Rojano at La Palapa. He is so attentive, friendly and helpful. We had the best brunch and time at the beach in the Royal Service section when we were waited on by Joel. He's the best!!!! We would recommend Joel to anyone! Thank you Joel for making our stay so relaxing and awesome!

findings.title: Rajesh Y. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
How often you get better than expected :)
Paradisus gave us that experience. We enjoyed every moment we stayed there. I really hope we have hotels like Paradisus in more places around the world. I really doubt we can really find one. 

If we had child care service few more hours after 9 PM it would have been great.

findings.title: Rob K. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Loved this resort!!!  Went there with my family recently for 5 days.  The pools was huge and gorg!  I had a massage at YHI spa which was amaze balls!!  The main atrium area takes your breath away.  Yes the rooms are not the most up to date but everything else was great.  The staff was more than helpful, kind and appreciative!  Restaurants that are a must....Bana for Asian fusion and a surprise performance, market grill for authentic tacos, and Enso for lovely creative outdoor cuisine!

findings.title: Nakisha A. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
My family and I stayed at the resort for four nights and five days. I will start by saying my party consisted of me, my husband, and my two boys ages 12 and six. So I'm going to break this review down into categories.

Food- The resort consisted of 10 restaurants. One of which was only available to club members. All of the restaurants were amazing. Our favorite was the buffet. The buffet during breakfast and lunch had every food you could possibly think of. They even had a theme night where it was all seafood. We also ate a an authentic Mexican restaurant. Now we know what REAL tacos taste like there is no going back to fast food tacos. There was a lot a latin restaurant, a nightly buffet set up by the pool of international foods. You could eat as much as you wanted all day. I will include adult beverages in the food. A must have drink is a blue Hawaiian at the resort. No idea what's in it just trust me on this. The drinks were great not watered down either.
There is also an ice cream stand but it's only open select times which isn't great. There is also a coffee and frap stand like here own Starbucks I didn't try it either.

Room- we stayed in the lowest grade room the lagoon view delux. It had a balcony as well. The room was was nothing fantastic but it was clean. The bathroom however was fantastic . The shower had two shower heads one right over your head and another detachable one. There was a door you could close off the toilet and there was a regular toilet and a Lady cleaning toilet. The bathroom was stocked every day with lots of soap, body was, and shampoo I took 12 Home.  The room was also stocked with a mini fridge with sodas and snacks like Oreos and chips. This is included so eat up. I even got extra on the way out for the plane ride. 

Service- The service was by far the best I've gotten anywhere. The staff remembers you from day to day. Hey interacting with my kids. They were genuinely happy to help you. Room service is included which my kids used quite often and hey still came with a smile. 

Kids Club- the kids club has a separate baby club that I did not use. My boys begged to be dropped off at the kids club. It was a big room with a play station and couch. And an indoor gym like chick fila. The kids are welcome from 9am-9pm but if they are doing a special event you have to rsvp like they did ceramics while we were there. There is one attendant and sometimes a lot of kids. I was fine with it because my older son is 12 and could look after his brother but not sure about little ones.

Pools- There are four amazing pools at the resort. One is adult only and one is he kids pool. They are all huge and you don't feel crowded. If you prefer the beach it's right infront of the pools with beach chairs and umbrellas. And you can rent cabanas at an extra cost.

Entertainment- so I saved this for last because it's the only reason I did not give the resort five stars. The entertainment was lacking significantly. So every night there is a family show at 8:30. My first pet peve is we never knew where it was just walked around looking for it. One night was a man juggling, one night a light show, one night Elvis show. All nights it was boring in fact most people left before it was over and my kids fell asleep. There is also a red lounge club open every night. The DJ played Latin music the whole time we were there. I would suggest a more variety of music and definitely line dances that always breaks people out of their shell.

Ok so over all my family loved this place. My six year old cried when it was time to leave and secretly I hated to leave to. It's a great resort for families and couples. You can buy excursions on site, exchange your money, and it's right on the beach (though a lot of seaweed), you walk right out the resort and down the hill and public transportation is right there. There is also and aqua park across the street in walking distance. Overall I would go back and I would recommend to anyone but plan on entertaining yourself because it's lacking in that department.

findings.title: Emily N. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
I strongly DO NOT recommend Royal Service Paradisus Cancun. This resort is actually the WORST one I've ever been to in Cancun and I've gone at least 5 times. Before coming here, my family and I were very excited since we upgraded to the Royal Service where you get additional benefits and a "butler" that is supposed to make your experience better. This was not the case.

To start off, they offer a free shuttle service however, after emailing them continuously for 2 weeks, they FINALLY replied about providing a shuttle for my family the night before our flight out to Cancun. But by then, we had already booked our own shuttle ride to the resort because we did not want to be ride-less. 

The check in process was absolutely terrible. It took them 3 hours to check us into our rooms. I understand that with a slightly big party (8 people), there may be some delays... However it took them just as long to check in a family friend of ours who only needed one room for her and her husband. It just seemed very unorganized as the staff shuffled through a bunch of paperwork. It was as if they had no idea we were coming and asked us so many questions. We had already paid for the rooms through their online website yet they asked us who was paying for the rooms and requested our credit card after scanning all of our passports. We told them that we paid already and had to pull up our confirmation as proof of payment. It was just very frustrating to have already booked our stay and have everything so unorganized. When we asked them why the check in process took so long one of the staff members answered back with some attitude saying that "here at Royal Service, it usually takes a bit longer because we're more personable" which to me just sounded like an excuse for their incompetence. 

When we purchased the Royal Service online, there was a promotion going on where if you spent $1500, you would receive a $500 credit for resort services (basically a coupon book) and a 3 course meal at one of their restaurants, Tempo (which is the only restaurant you have to pay for). We had to mention this deal to the staff while checking in but they had no idea what we were talking about so we showed them a screenshot of the deal. They acknowledged that we had the $500 credit but said they didn't know anything about the restaurant. We asked our female butler about the promotion and she later confirmed that we were guaranteed a 3 course meal at Tempo and came up to my mother's room to tell her that she made a reservation for our family for 2 days later at 7pm. So the day came and we all got dressed to go down to the restaurant for our reservation. When we got there, the hostess told us that we did not have a reservation at all and that maybe our butler forgot to book it for us or there was something wrong with the communication system. They called our butler but instead of coming down to solve the problem, her boss came and basically told us that our butler told her that we NEVER confirmed with her about our reservation! My mother was so upset because our butler knocked on her door and came into her room to tell her about the reservation 2 days prior. Rather than admit that they made a mistake, she tried to blame my mother for not confirming with her about the reservation for the restaurant. They didn't offer to fix anything about it so we were left to fend for ourselves for dinner in a resort where ONLY 2 or 3 OUT OF 9 restaurants DON'T take reservations which is ridiculous because if you don't reserve a spot in advanced, you have to eat at the same restaurants over and over. 

The only thing I can compliment Paradisus on is that the resort is beautiful and the beach is fun but all of that is downgraded by their terrible restaurants, poor service, and communication. The food was mediocre. I've had way better food at other resorts that were way cheaper than Paradisus. The maintenance was also very bad. There was no hot water and when we notified our butler, she said she would send someone up to fix it but they never showed up only to have them call us way later telling us that the pipes were broken and that it would take at least 3 hours to fix. Also, the ONLY elevator in sight for the Royal Service side was broken down for hours so staying on the 7th floor was not a fun trip. I also did not understand why they don't have a separate elevator for their maid staff because the guests and maids were using the same elevator making it inconvenient for both sides and it literally took forever. You were better off taking the stairs! Because the maids also used the elevators to transport their cleaning cart, the elevator always had a weird smell in there. 

I am never coming back here. I do not recommend this resort. Your money is better spent elsewhere...

findings.title: Yesenny M. (1/5)
findings.snippet: The hotel itself is great, I previously had it at a 5 Star rating, but then the facts were painted differently. Within 24hrs of arrival, we signed a Service Agreement for Room Upgrades at any resort as part of Club Meliá. Everything we were told were lies!!! Sales person Adrian, and his Portuguese Manager named Artur, compiled lies, withheld disclosures, and ultimately scammed us. They make everything they do as complicated as they can so it takes you a bit to figure out how bad you got taken advantage. Even after attempting to cancel within 24hrs, it's your words against this "Network". We're in the process of filing with the BBB. Google Club Meliá scams, it's pure deception!!!

findings.title: Aaron H. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
Oh Yea! Cancun is the place to be!  Out of the only 2 places Cancun vs Cabo.  I ratter come to where the water is blue and calmer so you can actually get in the water.

The services here was fantastic, can't be happier here with the people here. They seems to always be busy and happy working here. 

The room are clean however the switches in the room had no labels and most of them didn't make sense in our room and there was light bulbs out. 

Paradisus is an inclusive hotel but it doesn't really mean "inclusive".  I tried looking in to it before I went there but there wasn't much information.  The cost of other things on top of the "inclusive" is the royal service.  For us it was about $50-$60 more per person + per night.  So that can rack up pretty quickly.  What you get is a better side of the hotel where all the royal service are, 24hr butler(you get room service if you don't pay for it as well).  1 additional bar/restaurant that you can go to.  The other things you need to pay for is 1 restaurant there that is highly rated(in yelp terms its $$$), massage, activities, excursions, cabanas and other small things.

The food here about a 2/5, nothing that will WOW you.  And there was a few thing that was good, but not much.  So don't come for the food.

Pro:
Great services by mostly everyone

Con:
Seems very sale-ly kinda place
Smoking is allowed everywhere outdoors(even smoking in the pool)
Inclusive doesn't meant everything is included at this hotel
Food was okay

Tips:
Set up your pick up and drop off before you get there with your travel agent, taxi will rip you off. Go online and pre-pay it. 
If you want to get free stuff take 2hrs out of your vacation to listen to their timeshare presentation.(its very boring-don't get sucker into buying it, we did the math on it and it's also a rip off)

Final thoughts:
I would come back to Cancun, they are a little bit better than my Cabo trip.  I will stay at another hotel next time were they mean inclusive.  This place is a pass for me if I come back to Cancun.

findings.title: Sandra H. (1/5)
findings.snippet: Husband vomited after eating beans /rice @ Blue Agave. Guest desk refused to let me speak to a manager because they were in a meeting, but no manager ever contacted me all day/ night. The food is awful & service even worse. Taxis blocked only street, so we were stuck in Playa Del Carmen unable to get back to this hotel in Cancun.A lady had her purse stolen on the street. First & last trip for us to Mexico. Not a vacation !!

findings.title: Peter G. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
This is an extraordinary resort. 5 pyramids - #5 is The " Royal Service" - costs a little more but is AWESOME - a personal butler books dinner for you each evening - it is adults only - a private pool and a private beach section (great beach, sand, turquoise sea) all with fantastic service. Management must have a great training program. All inclusive - the food is good, some of the 9  restaurants are better than others, we liked Vento - for about $100 / person Tempo is white glove/silver service and is a delight and worth every peso.
Royal Service gets you premium liquor and a better selection of beers/wines. We spent most of our days at the beach/pool - Marcus and Jose looked after us SO well. Our waiters, Hector, Joel & Victor at La Palappa (poolside) are excellent - great food / breakfasts/grilled shrimp for lunch - best place to be with a good book. 
We had such a good experience that less than 24 hours after getting home we booked to go again in a few weeks, this time for 2 weeks. We can see ourselves going back MANY more times.

findings.title: T M. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
Had an amazing vacation! We were treated like royally! This was our 3rd year back and cannot wait to go again next year!! I have no idea how people are complaining about anything in regards to this hotel. Ate at every restaurant with great food and great service from everyone we encountered. If we had questions about anything and the person we asked didn't have an answer they would get someone else to answer our questions. Got an HOLA from everyone we encountered. Karina at Cocos bar went above and beyond for us and remembered us from our previous trips there, Manuel at the main pool (CoCos area) never let our drinks go empty or go without food and gave us the best poolside service anyone could wish for. Our Butler George went above and beyond to make our birthdays and our trip one we will never forget!! 
Just an FYI, the staff works long hard days mostly in the heat under sweltering unforgiving sun and dealing with some very entitled feeling people and they do it 6 days a week some 10-12 hours a day and most for 20.00 a day!! YES it is an all inclusive resort BUT even a dollar tip means the world to them!! We tipped everyone who waited on us and cleaned our room and the thanks and appreciation was overwhelming. We all know how good it feels to be appreciated so please remember that next time you go to this resort or any resort, they are people just like you and me, most have never been outside of Mexico. If you give respect and appreciation you most certainly get it back, be kind to others....the world needs more of it
  PS...as for the seaweed on the beach, yes this year there was a lot of it because of the weather pattern (last 2 years NO seaweed on beach) and as we all know we nor they can control that and yes they send out a truck every morning to help clear it out and also staff during the day but this year it was very hard to stay on top of it so just walk over it and enjoy the beautiful warm turquoise water

findings.title: Thomas U. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Best beach resort in Cancun . Locations location location, aquaworld (if you are interest in water sports you can do them here , they had promotion of three activities for $140 we did parasailing and jungle tour) is right across the boulevard. Lots of restaurants and great service. I have some photo here

findings.title: Haley B. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
The rooms for Royal Service are nice - no denying that.  The rest of the building and styling looks extremely dated and things are noticibly shabby. The food is ok, but it's impossibly difficult to get a dinner reservation. Skip room service unless you just don't want to leave to get food somewhere else.

The biggest let down is the service. We got a Butler as part of the Royal Service that is meant to take care of everything for us. He was nonresponsive when we tried to get anything - reservations for dinner, no Cabana reservations, pillows, nothing. We ended up doing everything ourselves.

All that combined with the fact that this place isn't cheap, you're better off shelling out a little extra for a better place, with better food, and better service.

findings.title: Hamdi A. (5/5)
findings.snippet: I had the best vacation in my life and I'm definitely coming next year here again if they still have the same service I love this place I will not go anywhere els

findings.title: Yana P. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
I have been to a variety of resorts in the area and this is definitely my favorite resort! Paradisus is truly a Paradise!

Something to keep in mind, I do not look for a party hotel and enjoy relaxation during my Cancun vacation. If you are looking for crazy parties, this may not be the best place. Furthermore, I always stay in the adults only - Royal Service area which is separate from the general hotel area, so this review is based on that. 

Having said that, this hotel is fantastic!

Environment 
There are a lot of beautiful decorations, water and plants inside the hotel. Whether it is raining or extremely hot outside, I love the fresh feel and atmosphere. The Royal Service has its private hall lounge area with pools of water, plants, beautiful lights, alcoholic beverages and a mini buffet. It looks and feels like a garden in a faerie tale. There is a large main hall with beautiful greenery and pools as well. My favorite restaurant (Bana) is hidden amongst the plants right in the middle!

The hotel boasts a lot of cabanas that are brilliantly located around the pool and beach area in the Royal Service area. They are not guaranteed for the entire stay, but depending on occupancy you should be able to reserve it for a big part of it.

Food
There are tons of restaurants, an amazing buffet and little snack areas with coffee and ice cream set up! I recommend the restaurants Bana and Fuego. The Royal Service area has its own private restaurant, The Palapa which serves delicious custom made breakfasts and lunches! A lot of the restaurants like Palapa, Nao and Fuego face the ocean which is makes the experience that much more enjoyable. 

Service
Truly a highlight of this establishment! The management and the team here are fantastic. I have come to this resort for the past 10 years and the service never changes. Always amazing! Everyone is always friendly and trying to go above and beyond in every aspect of the experience. Take the waiters at the pool for example, they are checking in as our drinks get lower and quickly bring another round when we need them. I have never had faster and friendlier service anywhere else in Cancun. They have a button to call a server in each cabana, and I never have to use it as they consistently appear out of nowhere.

Beach
The beach area is extensive with room for 2 lines of beds, a nice gap and the area for people to walk near the water. The water is pretty clean and the beach is nice. No rocks. The only downside is that it's windy, but that's common for Cancun. (tif you want less wind and calm water, go to Isla de Mujeres)

Potential Improvements
Overall I love this place, but there is always a little bit of room for improvement. A few quick suggestions:

1. Expand the gym area. The trend is heading towards working out, even during vacation.
2. Add a smoothie shop. I think the additions for gelato and coffee are awesome! Take it to the next level and add a smoothie place with healthy veggie options.
3. Add a hospitality room so that people can change and go to the beach if the rooms aren't ready. I have seen other hotels doing this.

findings.title: scott c. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
My wife and I are both in bed with chronic food poisoning. 

The hotels food handling procedures are atrocious. The buffet food is kept luke-warm, one huge Petri dish. I could go on but you get the message. Be warned

Update: three days later and still in bed. No help from the hotel whatsoever. Tried to cancel a scuba trip but they said they need a doctors certificate that they could supply for US$130. I need to spend US$130 to "maybe" get a US$180 refund. Do not stay here.

findings.title: Castro N. (4/5)
findings.snippet: The resort is amazing! Nacho at breakfast was fantastic he is great! Good food  at blue aguave was fantastic. The beds at the pool are overpriced they were always empty they should reduce the price and more customers would rent them!

findings.title: Jennifer S. (5/5)
findings.snippet: We just returned from Paradisus and it was an amazing experience. We received royal service! The all inclusive option is the best choice. We had great food and drinks the entire time we were there. The people were friendly and the facilities were immaculate

findings.title: Steve G. (5/5)
findings.snippet: We had an amazing time. All inclusive done really well. Only thing I would say is that you need to make dinner reservations first thing every day so you're not stuck at the not so popular offerings. Top shelf liquor too.

findings.title: Brittany M. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
Take me back!! Everything about my vacation here was amazing!  I came here with some friends to celebrate my birthday and we were treated like Queens.  The vacation started off bumpy due to our first room not being upgraded.  We complained about the room and told them it was my birthday.   A couple hours later, we received a room upgrade with a nicer view and birthday balloons and cake! 

I went mid March and the weather was perfect (not too hot or cold).  The food here was great and they had lots of variety.   One of the highlights of the trip was the spa.  It's like you're in a hidden oasis and the prices weren't too bad.  There's also plenty entertainment during the day and cute events in the evening.  I'll be back!

findings.title: Amy M. (1/5)
findings.snippet: My husband tried to do a nice thing and book this hotel for my 40th birthday as a surprise. Well, he booked it without realizing that our daughter had a medical procedure taking place on one of the days we would be away. I tried to call the hotel so that we could move the trip to the following weekend (NOTE: I DIDN'T WANT TO FLAT OUT CANCEL, I WANTED TO RE-BOOK FOR THE FOLLOWING WEEKEND!) and even provided the medical documents proving our dilemma. THIS HOTEL DENIED ME NUMEROUS TIMES. I CAN NOT BELIEVE THAT AN EXCEPTION CAN NOT BE MADE. It's just unethical. I don't care how gorgeous this hotel is or how many great reviews it has received. It is shameful that they aren't flexible. Even the airline is willing to change my flight! You may not care, Paradisus because in this messed up world it's all about the almighty dollar, but shame on you!

findings.title: Jim O. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
There was a couple of glitches here and there, but honestly, this is an amazing resort with some of the friendliest and helpful employees I have ever experienced. Beautiful architecture and decor inside and out. Lot's of food choices, great drink menu - and everything you need to have an amazing vacation! 

We had to check in late the first night and had heard the stories about the difficulty with restaurant reservations. We decided to try anyway and walked up to the hostess at Mole and explained we were traveling all day and had really hoped to have a nice dinner. She smiled and told us they would have a table for us in an hour. And dinner was amazing!

Every employee we came in contact with (except 1) was helpful, personable, and seem to try hard to make our stay as wonderful and stress-free as possible.

The only negative we had was our dinner at Enso. It was not at the same level as the other restaurants we ate at - and the waiter was not attentive or helpful when we complained about a couple of the items we received. It's too bad, because it could have been the perfect stay!

findings.title: Yü Y. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Great experience and special thanks to the following hotel employees - always kind and helpful - Ebraham Franko, Daniel ( Head of La Palapa), Cesar and Mosises ( La Palapa team). Would love to come back again some day.

findings.title: Heather O. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
I have to say, I was overall quite pleased with this hotel. Upon check in everyone was friendly and helpful. We upgraded to the royal services (without the butler ) for a few additional perks. I would say to just go all in and get the butler though as it would have been nice to have them take care of everything for us. 

PRO TIP: If you don't do the royal service then sign up for Club Melia (their rewards program) this way you can get a free cabana by the beach or pool the first day and only $10 a day after that (normally much more). These cabanas are actually much better than the royal service cabanas as you can choose where you'd like to be with these. 

The food was just ok most places, but I have yet to see an all inclusive in Cancun with spectacular food without going to somewhere like the Ritz. I do want to say we did frequent the buffet Naos due to our waiter, Martin. He was amazing and went out of our way to make our meal enjoyable. We went out of his way to have lobster tails made for us on the 2nd and 3d night even though it was not being served those days.

Make sure you ask for all your drinks to be doubles. As with any all inclusive drinks can be really watered down. I think when I asked for a "double" it tasted more like a single, so definitely go that route.

Beware your room key deactivates at noon on your checkout day. We got to the room at noon (our fault) to grab our stuff, but ended up temporarily locked out. We thought we had to rush to get all the food/drinks we could before checkout at noon, but it turns out that wasn't necessary. What really impressed me was that after we checked out at noon they let us keep ur bracelets to continue enjoying food/drinks. This was really awesome because our flight wasn't until 4pm. If you can, try to fly out later and take advantage of all the good this hotel has to offer after you checkout!

Also, if you rent jetskis here you'll have to walk down the beach to the front of The Grand Oasis to ride them. If you do this, DO NOT go anywhere near The Grand Oasis as it is an unsafe hotel (see my last review on that hotel) to be near. The beach/jet ski area was fine though. The guys were very friendly/accommodating at the jet ski rental place (Aquaworld).

findings.title: Sebastian B. (5/5)
findings.snippet: This is by far the best resort I ever stayed at. Took my girlfriend here for her birthday and we loved it. The staff was awesome very helpful and nice. Only bad experience I had was the room and Spa. I had reservations for a King size bed ocean view but when we got to the room it was two separate beds, when I went down to the lobby to let them know they said they all the King size bed are booked . Now with the Spa it wasn't a big deal but it still got me upset, we originally had an appointment for 6:30pm but on the day of the appointment I called in and asked if there was an opening and they told me yes at 11am so we got up early and went down to the Spa to find out that they didn't know what I was talking about . We ended up going to 6:30 but I forgot the reservation papers in the room so I went up to get it which it didn't take me more the 10 min and when I got back we paid to have a 50min massage but since I forgot the paper and it took me 10 min we only got a 40min message, when I ask the lady if she can just let it slide and give us the full 50min she said she can't because then she would have to deduct time from the next couple massage, but come to find out after we was the last couple there  so they could have done it. Other then does two incidents we had an awesome time the food was amazing! Pool & beach was beautiful the wings you get at the pool are the best and the drinks where awesome. I loved my stay here and I would definitely come back again and recommend it to anyone! Oh and if your look for an excursion to do Xplor is the best park to go too!

findings.title: Josh M. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
This has been by far the best resort I've ever been to. From the second we pulled up every thing was tended to. I can't say thanks enough to the staff for how helpful they were. Food, drinks, and the beach  were outstanding.
Not much of a "yelper" but I had to download the app just to write my thanks. Highly recommended!

findings.title: Vince B. (2/5)
findings.snippet: Four of us traveled here to attend a private wedding involving only 20 people.  ALL four of us became victims of "Montezuma's Revenge."  As we were leaving I learned others there for the wedding suffered similarly but to different degrees.  We didn't all eat or drink the same things.  The only thing we had in common was we never left the property.  So who knows the cause, but it had to be food, water, ice?  It's like the stories you read about cruise ships where a few people get sick and it spreads through the whole boat.  But for the revenge, I'd be giving this place close to 5 stars.  Exceptional service, great facilities, great beach, beautiful rooms etc.

findings.title: Nigel H. (4/5)
findings.snippet: This place is great, the staff is very attentive, the food at all of the restaurant is good and the drinks are . My new friends Pasqual, Armando and Christian (at Naos Buffet) took care of us every morning for breakfast.

findings.title: Tops U. (2/5)
findings.snippet: Well the resorts is as beautiful as they come. The rooms are great even the basic ones and everybody gets a balcony. However, the food is down right terrible if your use to great steaks, seafood that doesn't include tuna and octopus and overall exquisite taste. The free included Photo shoot is a total waist of time unless you want to spend at least 350 US dollars on 17 professional photos at the least or 25 each. WTF The best restaurant Tempo actually cost and is not included in the all inclusive so why‍‍that's is a serious bomber. If your looking for night life you won't find it here it's more of a relaxation kind of a place and for couples mainly. The staff are mainly friendly for the most part but some are very rude and lack a sense of service but only in the restaurants. Do not eat at Feugo if your not a fan of many kinds of seafood they only have nasty steak, raw or cooked Tuna, octopus and shrimp that all have a little twist that's so unnecessary. Definitely had some plumbing issues due to stopping up of tubs and sinks. Their 8:30 shows are horrible and not entertaining at all unless your a 4 year old toddler. The buffet is ok but you should definitely stick to the traditional Mexican food here or leave the resort to eat. Absolutely do not waist your time on the MELIA CLUB tour unless you travel quarterly and have 15k or more to spent on it at the least. Last and most important the drinks. The drinks are likely watered down with much ice and juice you'd have to strictly stick to beers, shots and wine if you plan to get a little waisted. I'd stay here again but will not drink, party or eat here ever again.

findings.title: Pipi H. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
We just had an amazing time there in January. The balconies are really nice sized to hang out on as well. The rooms are kept clean, the maid service is great and the minibar is stocked everyday. 

Every single employee we came across was super friendly and most went above and beyond to make us feel at home. 

The delicious food which varies from day to day with excellent service. We had a wonderful stay and our toddler enjoyed the sand beach so much.

findings.title: Daryl M. (2/5)
findings.snippet: 2 stars for the check in process and their room view. It took almost two hours to check into my room. The check in process is a company let's joke. The first 45 minutes I waited in line only to be told my room would not be ready for 35 minutes. The second time I waited for about another45 minutes only to be given a "ocean view" of a roof.

findings.title: Kris L. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
One of the most amazing resorts I've ever been too!  All Inclusive resort, great friendly staff, amazing hospitality service from every single person. Over 8 Amazing restaurants Noas For Anytime Of The Day! The Blue Agave Authentic Tacos and Quesadillas And Of Course Tequila. I Love Drinks So If You Do Also It's No Way You Wouldn't Enjoy. 

The rooms are very spacious and luxurious with a large terrace overlooking the Cancún ocean. On site painting for ALL Ages. Mr Esteban Did An Amazing Job At Finishing What I Started. He Was Very Helpful and Prices Very Reasonable And Just Overall 20 Thumbs Up From Me. 

If your looking for a relaxed get a Way with your Significant Other Family Or Even Yourself. This Should Be Your Next Destination. The only disadvantage is most TV Channels In Spanish But You Don't Even Need The TV On To Get Some Relaxation So Much More To Do. Being Right Accross From AquaWorld Excursions is A Plus With Over 10 Actives To Do . I Recommend The Aqua Twister Tons Of Fun !!!!! I Could Go On And On About How Amazing This Place Is But Just Know Paradisus Cancún, Mexico Is Where You Should Be Soon !! I Will Definitely Be Back Soon !

findings.title: Noah G. (3/5)
findings.snippet:
This was one of the nicest hotels I've ever stayed at. But, I believe it could have been better. 
-Smells in the lobby and all over that were unbearable
-Some food not thoroughly cooked
-no washing machine so you must pay for your cleaning (crazy prices) 
-Overcharged for everything if not all inclusive 
-Some personal things. 

Other than that, the hotel is very beautiful and the beach is so pretty and clear, but it honestly got old very quickly.

findings.title: Pete D. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
This is a tough one. And here is the whole story so grab a drink and hang on!   This was a Celebration for an 80th birthday party for Mrs. Fugiel. So the eleven of us fly to Punta Cana The Paradisus Real Resort, A wonderful site, coming from Detroit and 15 degrees this looks unbelievable. The view, the people are the Best. But the company is way off course. This is where things get derailed. For three days we couldn't use the shower or we would flood the bathroom as it wouldn't drain. We called and and we called. Every time no problem we get it fixed. Not until I said that I wasn't going to pay the bill did we get any service. As I was telling you we started with a group of 11, so we thought we'd be rooms near the group right? Well that was how it was planned.  But no, our rooms are quarter-mile away from everybody else. It only gets worse, next to our room the cabana is being remodeled, starting at 7:45 am jack hammering. Yea that's what you want to hear after a night of drinks, dance, partying and laughing.  Yea NO every day, all day even in the rain! This story is going to get worse a lot worse. Our room is next door to the Theater Olympus where all the events are done. Including a rock and roll band. Ok this makes for a bad time, that's right, hard rock until 11:30 just what every 60 plus couple wants. And the phones don't work. Man I'm glad we leave in the morning. 

Ok but there is a good side it's the people. So Kind and warm. All of them have been wonderful. We cannot say anything bad about them. But there is no recourse or solution. Love people like Johathan I met at the wine bar a great person with a true heart for the people. And many many more kind persons committed to the service and comfort of the patrons.

In contrast the company is completely void of any compassion to the real problem was the faceless company and the day-to-day existence of the clientele. Everything is a challenge everything is a complication and everything they say will take care of it and nothing gets done. 

My sister in-law and her husband are members and never had been so mis-treated for such a huge amount of money invested.  They had their reservations 3 months ago only to be told when we arrived that they cannot stay at the "RESERVE" which is their home base. Only to be told "sorry" you've been bumped down to just a master suite by the way is what our group reserved just 3 weeks ago on cheap tickets.  Their exclusive membership they pay a fortune for got them really nothing more than the rest of the group that we paid one tenth the price.  Shameful, very misleading and an outright scam.

I'm sad to say that I will never come back even though I will truly miss kind hearted people that  made the event a not so wonderful vacation so memorable.

findings.title: Rob L. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
I cant believe all the negative things being said about the hotel. This is the best by far for food, service, staff and room. If you are thinking about a trip to Cancun this is the place to stay. 

P.S. 
I believe all the negative comments are from plain assholes!!

findings.title: Nika F. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
Under no circumstance should you stay at this hotel. I have been staying at all inclusive hotels for years and this is the absolute worst experience I have ever had.
Majority of the people working there are rude and careless. It seems that most of them are unhappy to be there. We had do deal with their attitude throughout our entire trip. If you want to go somewhere you can relax and enjoy yourself this is NOT the place. 
The food is horrible. Both the restaurants and the buffet have low quality food. The room service menu is minimal and always had only half the menu available. It took about an hour to get the food so it was always cold. 
There is a club that plays music from 10pm to 2am every single night. So if you are staying in the main building you won't be getting any sleep. There is loud music and loud people roaming the hotel every single night. No one at the front desk told us this when we checked in and would not change our room when we complained about the noise. 
It's sad that such a beautiful hotel is so poorly unkept and managed. Do not stay here. Save your money and choose another all inclusive hotel that actually cares about its guests!

findings.title: robin w. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
Amazing buffet and restaurants. Amazing service, very friendly staff. Rooms are nice it not amazing. Every night there's a different show which is high quality. Lobby and outlay of hotel is grand and impressive. The tours, which are standard for every hotel, are below my expectations and pricey. The beach off the hotel is beautiful. 

If you come to Cancun, this hotel is a great choice.

findings.title: Joanne L. (3/5)
findings.snippet:
Very clean, staff very friendly. Beautiful views and nice clean swimming pools. The Bali beds are nice and comfortable but there are other shaded seats you can sit on if you don't want to spend the extra money. I really enjoyed the swimming pool, as it was very very large and it extends out super far. There are places that are shallow for little kids as well. The food was honestly just okay, the presentation of the food was absolutely beautiful however I think the quality of the food was definitely compromised as it was mediocre at best (ie. calamari was literally hard as a rock, scallops tasted a little plastic-y, etc) but nonetheless an overall pleasurable experience!

The reason i took off two stars was we had some issues with one of the beds in the rooms. In the middle of the night one of our guests started to itch a lot while sleeping on his bed and started getting bumps all over his skin. Using flashlights we searched his bed and found little tiny bed bugs. Upon complaining, we were given a cot 2.5 hours after our complaint was received. Nobody slept that night and was grossed out and worried ab more bedbugs/being bitten. When we complained in the morning, asking to be compensated for THAT night (we wanted to be refunded for that nights room for one night) they told us there was nothing they could do for us and told us the bumps looked like "mosquito bites." When we showed them a video we took of the bugs on the bed, the on-site medic proceeded to tell us they look like "ants." Then they tried to get us to sign this contract stating that since they gave us medical attention, once we leave the hotel and if these bumps turn into something more severe, we cannot sue them. We gave the paper back and told them if these bites cause us any more problems we will press charges.

findings.title: Fizza S. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
Absolutely beautiful hotel, no doubt there. The beach is private, super clean and literally as blue as all the pictures look. Also the hotel is all-inclusive which means pretty much all places to eat/drink are included in your base rent, and there is definitely tons of food to go around.

However, the management SUCKS. Worst hotel management I've ever seen in my entire life, there were literally guests yelling at the staff while we were there. Your room will definitely not be ready by the 3 pm checkin, they will tell you you need reservations to eat anywhere halfway decent for dinner but everything will be full (but will magically open up spots when you start getting angry), they will make the biggest deal in the world about not having the credit card you prepaid with even though they never tell you that you need to have it  (and then charge another card, and NOT reimburse the first one so you end up being double charged) and whenever you ask to speak to a manager, the manager will ALWAYS be on a food break... seriously who eats lunch at 330 pm? The WORST people to deal with EVER and I've been to my fair share of hotels.

That being said, the staff that works the restaurants, beach area, cleaning and concierge is super nice, so it's just the management that is horrible. Would really recommend everyone to stay somewhere you don't spend half the day arguing with management, and calling your credit card company to get double charges taken off.

findings.title: Emmy L. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
Con: Terrible drinks ( both regular & alcoholic)
         Mediocre to terrible food for the most part
        Customer Service was hit and miss
        The doctor on hand is a total thief , have never paid this much before for a consultation & cold medicine even in the U.S. with out insurance!   $600! 
        No alcoholic beverages delivered to room
       Too many exclusions for all inclusive , & the staff will never tell you straight up if something is not included,  very sneaky.
         Out of beach towels frequently 
         Loud music at 9am! 
         Did not have the same amount of ease as all other all inclusives 

Pro: Easy check in
          Mini bar included in all inclusive
          Beautiful Beach area
          Beautiful hotel
          Blue Agave tacos and service was great

findings.title: Alexis L. (4/5)
findings.snippet: Wonderful resort, the only reason I'm giving 4 stars is due to the fact that the restaurants are hard to get reservations and when we would walk past them they'd almost be empty. When we finally did get reservations at the restaurants that required one in our all inclusive package, the service was extra slow and there wasn't enough waiters. The rest of the resort was beautiful and clean. Relaxing and amazing experience. It's nice to tip but the employees don't seem like they expect it and they were always so eager to help. Not many people got the royal service beach beds as far as I observed so I think that led to the butlers growing bored and they helped us and brought us drinks to the beach even tho we weren't royal service. Our room was always cleaned nicely, the mini bar and room service were super convenient and impressive. The ocean view from our room was excellent, we were on the third floor of pyramid 3. Anything we needed they sent to our rooms such as combs, toothpaste and tooth brushes, shampoo, lotions etc. The buffet and Blue Agave were great we even had a mariachi band play us a requested song at dinner for free but they appreciate tips. I would definitely go again to this resort

findings.title: Dianna C. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
The NEW Paradisus is great. What's great about it is the new extra services and LOVE Tempo restaurant. The location is also great, the beach is beautiful with clear water AND the Bali beds with lunch is wonderful. I also upgraded my membership and worked with Claudia Arriola who is as charming as she is smart - THANK YOU! The butler service and treats he gave were so wonderful - REALLY WONDERFUL. We had a two bedroom suite with kitchen and Jacuzzi on deck - def used :).

Best restarants - Tempo, Brazillian, Asian, taco and Buffet. The Mexican and Mediterranean (both times I left to go to buffet).

findings.title: Vanessa S. (2/5)
findings.snippet: I have to say this was one of the lower ranked resorts we've stayed at, the check in process was slow and confusing and they insisted on giving us a tour after we refused. Once on the pool deck (our room was not ready yet) we went to the pool side bathroom to get changed where it was flooded with toilet water, we then went inside to change and 2/3 stalls we're only working, they advertise topshelf liquor but the kettle one was gone pool side by end of day one and no attempts were made to get another bottle. When we finally checked into our room we had two double beds vs the king requested, they offered to push the beds together. The rooms themselves including the bathroom are extremely dark which make it hard to get ready- the bathroom also has no fan and is slippery when you exit the shower. We tried the Blue Agave the first night, we were not given choices and everything was served family style- decent enough but not great. The second night we tried Enzo, also family style, no choices, never asked about allergies. The pool bathroom again was flooded second day so each time had to go in to use the restroom, the stairs are also not well marked and dangerous, several people fell on them and we're injured. The last day there we moved our luggage and saw several little bugs on the table as well- not sure what they were. When we went to check out the checkout process was about as painful as the check in process and slow. Compared to other resorts in Cancun this one lacks on the food, drinks, and the nightlife.

findings.title: Selina C. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Very nice hotel, variety of food and tasty. Beautiful interior and exterior design. Fragrance is too heavy at the lobby.

findings.title: Lupe V. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Can I just say "WOW" We were greeted at the door with drinks by the staff... they made checking in so easy... we were given a tour of the resort...  our suite was so clean and spacious... they had my bed decorated with balloons and party string for my bday... oh and they had a small cake waiting for me! Omg the beds were so comfortable... the food was amazing!!!! Im very picky with my food and honestly this resort exceeded my expectations... the alcohol provided was top shelf... the pools were clean and amazing... the beach was so beautiful... the staff helped us book our tours and activities... we were never without a drink in our hand... the staff was amazing!!! We were treated like royalty! The club inside the resort was small but it was the best!!!!! We love to dance and the music they played was definitely the best... better than Hollywood!!! I honestly can't wait to go back!!! Thank you for making my Bday week so special!

findings.title: Jamie C. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
I give this 5 star because 95% of our vacation was beyond expectation.  However I do have to warn others DO NOT TAKE THE 90 minute sales pitch.  Yes it is easy to say no but you will NOT get what they promise you.  Once you say no, they treat you like an enemy, no smiles, not friendly, and they do not deliver on the incentives.  It's a bait and switch.  They say it's not a timeshare but it is.  The first offer is 50 years for $45,000 + $1100 maintenance fee per year which is not guaranteed to stay the same.  When you say no, the manager offers a trial for $12,900 + the maintenance fee.  That offer is for 20 trips.  Breaks down to $1645 per trip WITHOUT airfare, WITHOUT transportation to the hotel. We paid $1600 for our vacation which included air and shuttle through amstar.  The annual maintenance fee is likely to increase each year which makes their deal so much worse.  

I have to mention the receptionist at the Spa  who was so very rude.  We had prepaid for 2 massages and the woman was terribly rude in her mannerisms and speech to us.  We had a few questions upon arrival at the spa and she dismissed us like we were nothing.  Fortunately the massage relaxed us and we were able to let go of the tension she caused.  It did leave a bad taste in our mouth about the resort.  Hope management reads this and speaks with her.  She can learn from every other staff member at the resort how to be hospitable, welcoming, and friendly; especially for a spa.  

Now on to the good parts:
At checkin we asked about an upgrade and they gave us a free upgrade with an ocean view.  Beautiful room and amenities included.

At the beach, we stayed on the chairs under the constructed umbrellas.  No charge for these, no reservation.  Just arrive early for the best selection.  Staff comes and serves you drinks all day.  Other reviews mentioned you need Bali bed or cabana to get the service.  You don't.  It's free for everyone.  And awesome.  The wait staff was so much fun too.  They seems to enjoy their jobs and have fun with you.  Talk to them.  They treat you like you are their only customer and go out of their way to get you anything you need.

(We tried to get a Bali bed reserved, one of the promised rewards for the tour we took but when we reserved they limited the selection to locations that are inconvenient so we opted to just take the chairs on the beach instead.  Because the staff take care of you there, I don't see the point of the Bali bed.  It's not much more comfortable, and you are in the water most of the time anyway.)

We tried all the restaurants included.  The food was incredible everywhere.  The buffet was excellent, with different themes/selections each day.  

The staff was so friendly and helpful

Some tips: 
- bring cash for tipping.  Small bills if you can.  Getting change for a $20 usd was difficult.  The bellman came thru but often had only $14 so I had to wait til layer in the day. 

- make early reservations for dinners.  6-6:30 worked great.  Not many there then so you get extra attention.  If you are hungry later, stroll to the buffet.

findings.title: Kiara A. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Amazing Resort! The staff is genuinely very nice and so helpful. The rooms are very clean and spacious. The restaurants are also very clean and very good too. Over all I had a great experience here and will definitely be coming back. We came when it was sea turtle nesting season. One night we went out to the beach looking for turtles and ran into Geovanny. His job is to protect the turtles and once born, set them free. He was truly great and was more than happy to answer all of our questions and teach us things we didn't know. I'm so grateful we got to be a part of that. We were able to pet some baby turtles and also set them free into the ocean. It was a beautiful experience. Thank you Geovanny for the experience and thank you Paradisus for a wonderful weekend!

findings.title: Veronica R. (1/5)
findings.snippet: Scammers everywhere !! Horrible check in process, they go on and on about this meeting you need to go to the next day ! They ask for a $20 deposit to go to this "meeting" which is just a time share scam that will rob you of at least 5 or 6 beautiful pool hours.  Don't make the mistake I did and just say NO... actually don't even bother coming to this hotel, go somewhere else where they don't harass you non stop.  They are very nice until there's an issue, our hotel safe didn't work and we waited an hour for the guy to come fix it and then 2 hrs for him to actually fix it !! I wish I would have stayed somewhere else !! Also be sure to bring the exact credit card you used to pay for the hotel, if you leave it at home and bring another one it's a BIG deal another couple of hours wasted dealing with this !! I wasted so much time with these people I wish I would have stayed somewhere else where they know how to run a hotel so that I can spend more time at the pool and less time waiting for people to fix stuff.

findings.title: Tanya A. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
The location of this hotel is great! Close to shops, in the "hotel zone" and a couple miles away from Coco Bongo.

I highly recommend getting an ocean view room- it's the only way to go! Everyone that works here was so nice and welcoming. Please remember to tip at restaurants because the servers have great service and work really hard :) 

I wouldn't recommend the restaurant Vento- when we went, half the menu wasn't available and the food wasn't impressive at all. The best restaurant is Mole- also the reservations are necessary. You have to call the morning before to get a reservation. 

After spending an amazing 5 days here, I highly recommend this hotel for friends, family and lovers! They have lots of awesome activities and shows available.

findings.title: Angelica Z. (3/5)
findings.snippet: i recently went on a get away with my boyfriend to this hotel and upon arrival i was impressed with the cleanliness and decor. the food was amazing but i do recommend to make reservations on arrival as they go very quickly. the pool was nice but it would have been better if there we're more chairs. the beach club also needs a little more life. One major complaint was that on our last day we were hanging in our cabana and heard gun shots right outside our resort on the beach. a man was shot down and many man with masks fled the scene. the man was unattended for an hour before police came and ambulance carried him through our resort pool. The staff tried their best to distract by having a zumba class but it was too late...most people saw and we felt very unsafe. what a shame we had to witness this because other than that it would have been perfect. i would like to stay here again someday but for now it seems very unsafe which is why its a 3 star and not a 5.

findings.title: Gail M M. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
The Paradisus is a lovely, elegant hotel.  Friendly staff and very nice pools and amenities.

They might consider updating their room technology.  Plugs were hard to find for charging devices and turning off the lights would also turn off the charging.  No USB ports.

Great bars, clubs, and Japanese restaurant.  I would return and recommend to others.

findings.title: Tommy H. (3/5)
findings.snippet:
I came here with a group of 60 people for a wedding. Yes, 60 people flew in from the United States and other parts of Mexico.

I had mixed feelings about this resort.I don't know if it was the fact that I was on vacation or because we were there with our loved ones, but I did not want to leave. I wanted to hug a palm tree and wait for a hurricane to blow me away rather than to leave on my own. (I ended up leaving dragging my feet with my head down, and suffered from withdrawals for a couple of weeks.)

So the resort itself is beautiful, just like the photos you see on their website. The staff is very friendly and was always quick to answer any questions you might have.

The check-in process, unfortunately, is one of the worst I've ever encountered throughout all of my travels. They are very pushy with convincing you to upgrade your room to "Royal Services". To be honest, there was nothing very "Royal' about it. You get a Butler that can only do so much for you, and you're out in the regular resort area all day. There's basically no time to use the butler service. You do get two bottles of alcohol in the room, but the entire resort is inclusive. There's no need for those bottles. I would opt out of the Royal Services package next time if I come back. 

Another one of the problems with the resort is that they depend too much on the overall asthetics and ignore the details. As we were walking through the resort on the first day, we noticed towels against walls on the floor. They were placed there to soak up leaks from the building, and there were many spots like that throughout the resort. They had major plumbing issues that needs to be addressed professionally. 

The food was also up and down, I think the best way to describe it is.. "In Mexico, stick to Mexican food." We tried the sushi restaurant called Bana, and it was very disappointing. It's as if the sushi chefs have no training. Please save your stomach and time and just omit this restaurant during your stay. On the other hand, Blue Agave was serving amazing tacos. We were there every single day of our stay and never got tired of their tacos and their drinks.

Overall, I would come back, it was my first resort in Cancun and will always have a special place reserved in my heart. Next time I come back, I'll be more experienced and will know what to do and what not to do.

findings.title: Ting Ting W. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
This is my 3rd time to Cancun and I was not impressed with my stay here at the Paradisus because of the beautiful pictures that I saw online. I booked a stay for 3 nights 4 days. When arrived to the hotel, it was beautiful, looked exactly like the pictures, but as we walked around and went into our room, we started to see that the hotel was super run down. There is also no central AC throughout the entire main hotel. We decided to upgrade to an ocean view room, but I do not think that it was went it. The way the balcony is structured, you don't get a good view from your room. There's a huge planter that covers the view and he concrete siding blocks the view as well. 

We had the all inclusive package but every time we ordered our drinks there was hardly any alcohol in the drinks at all. As for all the restaurants, you have to make a reservation a day in advance. When you call, they immediately tell you that all the restaurants are full and they only have the buffet and one other restaurant open. I did not spend all of this money to not be able to eat at any restaurants. When I started to complain, they all of a sudden had every restaurant available for whatever times I needed it for. Are you kidding me??? Every time we went by the restaurants, they were all empty. 

All the restaurants were gross. The only restaurant that was edible was buffet. We tried Fuego, Bansa, Enso, the Buffet. Honestly the food as drinks were not good at all. There are plenty other resorts that would be way better for the same price. Try the Dreams properties. 

Overall, I wouldn't return to this hotel and do not recommend it.

findings.title: Art D. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Great relaxing time. Overall I would visit again. I flew in Friday morning and left Monday afternoon. the service was excellent. I had my own butler (except it was a woman and don't know the name for a woman butler). She is there to plan every day if you need her to do so. Every time I turned around there was someone there to help me with what ever i needed, food, drink, whatever. It is a place to relax and take it easy. There are two sides, one is family and the other is adult. The kids are not allowed on the adult side which is cool because it is nice and quite. The rooms are okay but not outstanding. The food was pretty good for an all inclusive resort. The alcohol was like most resorts weak. There is a small golf course you can play and security was pretty good too. As for eye candy not much because you either go with your family are go with someone, there were not many people that looked solo. Overall good spot and would visit again. From Friday to Monday was $1.4k, not too bad.

findings.title: Leo P. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
Been coming to Paradisus for the past 2 years and have stayed at the Royal service both times. It gets better every time. Staff is very helpful and eager to please, attentive to your needs and professional. Carlos, the Royal Service manager is a top professional who will go above and beyond to please his guests and offer very kind of service to make your stay enjoyable. One of the reasons for coming back this year was the service Carlos showed me and my family last time. Just Super. Also the bartenders at the Red lounge are very friendly and professional, mostly Salvador, Roberto and Francisco. 
Francisco and Salvador have been here every time I came and I always appreciate the way they enjoy their job and make sure the atmosphere is amazing. They are the best guys around. The coffee shop is also nice, Andres showing his skills and doing an awesome job all the time. All in all, very good place to enjoy a nice vacation. Recommended

findings.title: Lisa W. (5/5)
findings.snippet: My daughter and I celebrated my 60th birthday at the Paradisus Cancun and loved every moment!  We stayed 8/2/2017-8/7/2017.   Upon arrival, check in was very quick.  They did not offer us the Royal Service...not sure why because I probably would have upgraded. But, I have to tell you, the service we received was excellent! They knew it was my birthday and when we entered our room there were balloons, confetti and cake with candles!!  It was such a great surprise and made me feel so great!  The hotel is beautiful and very clean.  Our room was beautiful ocean view.  The A/C worked very well, the beds were very comfortable. The hotel has a lot of foliage, which makes it so beautiful, so it is humid, but that was OK with me because it did not seem hot to me. The pools are wonderful, there is always different entertainment by the pool which was fun!   I felt the food was very, very good!  We ate at the buffet, they had lots of food stations outside which was convenient, and very good!  We also ate at the Japanese restaurant one night too which was good. The maids were excellent and kept our room clean and the mini bar stocked well.  Of course we tipped them  $5 every day we were there. I appreciated how they had our room cleaned early in the day.
