They deserve it; they work hard. In fact,  all the employees at this hotel work extremely hard and always have smiles on their faces.  I just can't recommend this hotel enough!! I can't wait to return....

findings.title: Grace Y. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
I have no RAGRETS that my first time in Cancun was spent at Paradisus Cancun. This all inclusive resort is as paradise as it gets with its intricate architecture and atmosphere that really heightens the sense of being on vacation. Being that it was all inclusive made the entire trip more enjoyable. There are a few restaurants that you can rotate from. For dinner, reservations need to be made. The most memorable restaurant goes to Blue Agave where you can order unlimited tacos, quesadillas, chips & guac, chips & salsa. And of course your choice of alcoholic beverage. None of the restaurants are going to be 5-star quality, so don't expect high quality fine dining at this all inclusive resort or you will be disappointed. 

The pool area is also very beautiful, with a view of the ocean front. There is a kiddy pool area to the back for those who have children. For adults without children, you can enjoy the swim up bar at the main pool. The walk to the beach shore is also right at your convenience. I would definitely come back here for any future trips to Cancun.

findings.title: Danielle W. (1/5)
findings.snippet: Beautiful hotel my friends stayed at but a bunch of assholes that work there. We wanted to look around and see if we wanted a day pass and they wouldn't let us.  My husband cut his finger and they wouldn't give him a band aid.  Bad rude service.

findings.title: James S. (5/5)
findings.snippet: I went to Paradisus with my wife, her niece and the nieces husband and a nine year old and four year old.  This is an all inclusive resort.  The food choices were plentiful and generally very good.  The sole restaurant that did not live up to expectations was the Brazilian restaurant.  The rest of them were very good to excellent.  The rooms were spacious and the free min-bar that was restocked daily was nice.  The service in the hotel, restaurants and around the resort was excellent!!!  All four of the adults in our group commented at one point or another that the restaurants and hotels in the USA could give their staff the service training that clearly was given at Paradisus.  We were there for 5 nights and enjoyed every minute.  They greet you with a cocktail as you check in.  There are vendors on site that can arrange any excursions that you may enjoy at a reasonable price.

findings.title: Ruthanne B. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
Stayed here for our honeymoon and it was amazing ! 
We did do Royal service and our Butler was amazing !! I loved the experience at Market grill you definitely need to bring an appetite, food was so good ! Blue Agave had the best Mexican food we also did sushi which was so good ! Honestly you can't go wrong with eating at any of the restaurants and the buffet was pretty good as well. I asked for avocado for my toast and they brought it to us they are there to make your vacation something to remember.. Oh and their coconut ice cream was so good it was a hit I would see so many people just come in to the buffet for just the ice cream and waffle bowls . 
Every night our bed would have roses and small little treats left behind . All the employees are so friendly and ready to chat it up . I can't wait to come back and bring our children. 
We also went off resort to shop and that experience was in all good fun ! 
I'm sure I am forgetting something to review on but my husband and I had an amazing time !

findings.title: Hailey M. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
Paradisus is one of the best resorts I have ever been to. So beautiful and so much nightlife. Everyone was so nice. My boyfriend and I did the all inclusive and it was totally worth it. We did not do the royal service and I do not think we missed out on much at all. I can't imagine our vacation going better than it did. So no regrets not choosing royal service. 

I recommend the blue agave, market grill, and the red lounge! All the food and drinks were sooo good at the blue agave. Best Mexican food I've ever had and I'm from San Diego (we have good Mexican food). The market grill was such a fun experience and had really tasty meat. You have to be really hungry if you go there. And the red lounge was so fun at night.  

I thought this resort was in a very good location. Right outside the hotel is the public bus stop. We took the bus to market 28 and it was all such a fun experience. 

I also recommend exchanging your money at the front desk in the hotel. 

Do not flush the toilet paper! Our toilet overflowed and the cleaning service was horrible. He checked out the toilet and said he would be back to clean up the toilet water. But never came back. I thought about complaining but everything else went so well during our stay, so it just wasn't worth it. Also, the chicken nuggets at the pool and ordered through room service was never cooked enough. But everything else was great!

findings.title: Rachel B. (4/5)
findings.snippet: This hotel was a great place to relax and kick back. The staff was attentive and nice. Food and drinks were great. It was a little hard to get reservations at the restaurants for dinner and since most of the restaurants require reservations, we didn't get to try all that we wanted to. You can only make reservations the day of and the reservation start period is 7:30am so we were still sleeping and missed the slots. The pools were beautiful and we really enjoyed the swim up bar. The beach is so relaxing and the wait staff was readily available. Not much of a night life but we didn't mind much. We had to go down to the beach early to get chairs and an umbrella and sometimes had difficulty getting seats. Highly recommend traveling to Isla de Mujeres for day trip. Overall it was a great stay in Cancun.

findings.title: Casey S. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
Had a wonderful vacation here with my fiancé! Very family friendly and much quieter than other hotels in Cancun. Many restaurants on the resort to choose from so you get variety with the all-inclusive. The rooms are very nice and the entire hotel layout (architecture, etc) was beautiful! The service is great and the people there are so helpful and nice. The beach is gorgeous with the cabanas and if you relax on the beach you are also able to order drinks or food if you want. Water is really warm so swimming is also a possibility too! There are a lot of activities to do nearby that the hotel makes it easy to sign up for while you're there. My fiancé and I went swimming with dolphins and went snorkeling as well (highly recommend the snorkeling!). We were also asked if we wanted to have a photo shoot done (complimentary and then if you like the photos you can buy anywhere from 1 to all of them, reasonably priced), which we said yes to. The photographer was amazing and very professional, the photos turned out wonderful! We actually ended up buying most of them and using them for our engagement photos. Overall we had an amazing time here and would recommend this resort to anyone.

Ps. The only negative thing I will say is BE CAREFUL with the use of debit cards to take out cash. I don't believe this is the fault of the resort but we used a debit card at the ATM in the resort and at the public ATM at the end of the driveway near the bus stop (believe it was this ATM where our card was hacked). Several months later there has been $1,500 in fraudulent charges on that card, and we are now dealing with the bank in getting that squared away. DO NOT USE DEBIT CARDS IN MEXICO!

findings.title: Sandra M. (4/5)
findings.snippet: We just recently spent 6 days in this beautiful hotel.   The rooms and few locations within the premises are in need of restoration but not a big deal.  We had an ocean view room that even though it was not too spacious it was comfortable.  The only reason I don't give the hotel a 5 star is because of the checking process.  My room was ready late and I had to complain several times. However, the staff, specially Rosita was extremely nice.  The gym classes were great!  The instructor was super nice and dedicated.  The hotel has good quality of food., the dancing show were all amazing. One more thing, be careful not to leave your phone unattended by the pool area, the bar tenders can't be trusted.  My sister's phone was stolen from her chair, we traced it and found it but it was a very uncomfortable situation.  Overall, this is a great resort and I  most probably stay there again

findings.title: Michelle H. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
Loved this place! I went in the off season so everything was very accessible. The staff was very friendly. Our favorite was Guadencio at Naos. He would take care of us every morning, we would ask to be seated in his section every time! Also Raul at the front of the hotel was amazing. Always getting us cabs and even on our last day made sure we made our flight on time(we partied a little too hard the night before) I could not believe how much fun this hotel was. Nightly shows, that were so much fun. We met some girls on one of our excursions that we're staying at another hotel and they told us they had half the things that Paradisus offered! And they paid more than we did!! I also appreciated that the staff helped me learn more Spanish (tiennes uno caballito de don Julio) Use it!

Also, I know they say tips are included but tip the wait staff! They make so little money that even a buck will get you the best service you can imagine.

findings.title: Ed F. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
First time to Cancun-business trip. Hotel was nice, closer to airport, right on the beach. Good amenities, plenty to do. A number of decent restaurants, nothing spectacular, but good food. This is an all inclusive resort so it was nice not having to sign an invoice or pay a bill.

PROS: good location, nice beach amenities, great staff and grounds. Good food.

CONS: The rooms could use a refresh, old, uncomfortable furniture, fixtures and beds.

findings.title: Jay T. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
2 stars because of the nice architecture and only good restaurant in there that was market grill. It was a Brazilian style restaurant. They bring you different meants and sides. At the buffet you get bored of the same stuff over and over, if you don't make reservations for dinner, this is where you end up.

When coming in to the resort on the first day, they wanna set up a breakfast with you early on the next morning to try to sell you a timeshare, they offer you "free courtesies". If you decline, they will consistently bug you about it. They kept blowing up my room phone, woke us up in the morning, left messages. We were fed up. The guys in the front desk know who you are, and know that you didn't make it to the breakfast, so we kinda felt black marked. 

The Royal service pool side was too stuck up, we were there a couple times for like 2 hrs and just left to the regular side because we didn't get offered anything. Not even 1 drink. (And we have all inclusive with the royal service bracelets, what's the point then?) They only served the people on the Bali beds that cost 100-150 to reserve. 

Idk, but on my last day I was ready to go home, next time I come to Cancun I'm definitely not coming here, or recommending this place to any of my friends.

findings.title: Scott l. (3/5)
findings.snippet:
The lagoon room is noisy. We could hear people talking, cart rolling, and big people footsteps outside of the thin door.  The AC is loud each time it runs.

The check in experience wasn't good either. Not sure why they squeeze everyone into a corner and there was no AC in that room.

I can say the food is decent so far.

findings.title: Chris T. (3/5)
findings.snippet:
The Lobby - 
Pros - 1) The hotel lobby us nice and reminiscent of the jungle with vines hanging from the ceiling/balconies.  The lobby is spacious with both stairs and elevators
Cons - 1) The Ac did not seem to work well in the lobby. It was hot and humid.  There were issues of leaky AC ducts in a couple of the restaurants we visited - Naos and Blue Agave and 2) They had air freshener sprays throughout the lobby that could become nauseating  3)The hallways and lobby were VERY dark at night

The Room -
The room was spacious and nice.  There was tile throughout and a nice sized bathroom.  

The pool and beach area -
The pool was very nice but unfortunately closed way too early at 7pm...does not seem reasonable since it is a vacation resort where people should be able to relax and swim until much later.  There was also not enough umbrellas at the pool area.  The beach access was nice with beautiful views and showers. The towel station is located conveniently between the pool and the beach.

Customer service
Customer service from the bell hop to reception to restaurant service and maid service was all swift and friendly.  Excellent

Restaurants
The restaurants were good.  Our favorite was the Market Grill and Mole.  The service at the restaurants was fast and friendly.

Overall, a nice hotel but the pool and towel stations closing so early was very disappointing.  Additionally, the lobby area was a bit hot so that is the reason for 3 stars

findings.title: Karen V. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
This hotel suited most of our needs quite well!
The staff was extremely friendly and courteous, and very quick with service.
The rooms could use a little TLC updating as the property is a bit older. But the view, we had an ocean view room and it was spectacular worth the extra money for sure.
Like most resorts you need to be up early to get a spot on the beach because they fill up by about 8am.
We have three teenagers and they needed a few more activities at this hotel to keep them from getting bored.
We found the entertainment so-so and quickly realized it was the same songs being sung night after night... A bit of variety would be nice.
The food was really good, lots to choose from and the restaurants were clean, well staffed, booking for the restaurants was a bit difficult as they rarely answered the call and I spent way to much time trying to book a dinner reservation. 
The location was great, with a bus stop right out front on the Main Street,  so we took the bus to the "party zone" a few time which was fun and easy to use, and the bus only cost $1usd! 
The beach was amazing, 
And the vendors on the beach were very nonchalant and respectful. We bought a tour from one vendor , Kinha jungle Cenotes, zip lining , quad tour all for 70$usd each, a highlight of our trip! Loved every minute of it! 
The beach waiters were super efficient and much appreciated... 
I would give this resort a 4.5 and recommend it to all!

findings.title: Nik K. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
Visited Cancún for a Cinco De Mayo wedding. No, I am not crazy. Lol! Upon checking in at Paradisus, we received cold towels and were greeted by two friendly hotels employees. We were told to find our shuttle guy on the second floor. It didn't take long to realize Paradisus could be quite confusing. However, we were finally able to figure out that tower 3 has 3 levels and we had to go to the second floor in our tower (the shuttle guy was near room 3150). 

You have to try the spa if you visit this place. I had an AMAZING massage from Pamela and my partner enjoyed his massage from Danielia. We are still dreaming about those hands!!! 

Naos is the place go to for breakfast because there is a buffet every morning. Interestingly enough, we found ourselves at Naos every morning. (Hello Atilano/Ati). We loved the tacos at Blue Agave. They were really good. We also dined at Market Grill, which is a Rodizio Syle restaurant. The meat was well seasoned and sides were tasty. We couldn't pass up the opportunity to try Thai food in Mexico so we also dined at Enzo, and enjoyed our meal there too. 
 
Our party had quite a few drinks here. The margaritas (with no ice), and bailey's were my favorite. 

Overall, this place is a hit! This is the only place I would stay if I have to revisit Cancún in the future.

findings.title: Kyle N. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
This is one of the best all-inclusive resorts in Cancún! I have been here multiple times, and I keep coming back. The resort is upscale, all suites; the rooms have been completely remodeled in 2016. But its strength by far is food; a variety of eight restaurants or so, covering all the major cuisines of the world. The buffet offers chef quality food throughout the day for all three meals and between. The all-inclusive formula is a plus, since you don't have to worry about a thing.
I always stay at Royal Service, the resort's club level for added tranquility when the resort is full, but honestly it's not necessary to enjoy the full experience, more like a personal choice.
Solid 5 stars!!!

findings.title: Raquel V. (4/5)
findings.snippet: This resort is large. I love the outside. I got married here. My wedding turned out amazing. The staff is nice. If you want a large room make sure to ask for the same room type but ask to be on the lower floor. The buffet is good. This is a fun place to stay at.

findings.title: Katherine B. (5/5)
findings.snippet: I went for my birthday 3 weeks ago and had an amazing time, the staff is very friendly. It can use a little bit of TLC since its been open for a while, but I recommend if you can pay extra get the balcony. The view is amazing from the balcony overall the resort was very relaxing and right on the beach, you also have Aqua world right in the front. I lovedddd it !!

findings.title: Paul G. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
Background: I stayed here for new year 2017 (Dec 31-Jan5). Stayed with a couple of my friends, one who had a timeshare at this resort. $80-90/day all inclusive fee based on how many days you stayed (more days = cheaper daily rate). Here is a video vlog about my trip: https://youtu.be/dOjyEiGG1HA

Food: 5/5 absolutely no complaints about the food. My favorite place was Vento hands down. Not sure if we were getting hooked up with the best dishes by our waiter or that was just the typical selection (but one night he did give us an off menu item so that was awesome).
Alcohol: 5/5 I mean they had everything we needed/wanted
Room: 5/5 We has a 2 bedroom suite. Place was huge, views were incredible, Housekeeping cleaned up well.
Pool: 4/5 Pool area was big, we couldn't use the cabanas cuz they were property of the beach bar i believe. Had a bar within the pool. The food by the pool could have been better but not really complaining. 
Gym: 3/5 The gym had everything you needed to get a full workout, it was a big space but it still seemed kind of cramped. Also old worn equiptment. The free weight section was limited, dumbbells went to 50lbs, smith machine, cable machine, a bunch of treadmills/ellipticals. Free lockers. 
More of a family resort than a party resort. So to each their own. depends what you are looking for. Concierge was all over the hotel. Room Service was incredible, especially after a night of clubbing. (they were pretty much open 24 hours) They had a decent menu.

findings.title: Judy Z. (1/5)
findings.snippet: If I could give this place zero stars I would... This is my 3rd time in Mexico, first time at this hotel, I only stayed here because of a friends wedding. The service was slow the drinks are watered down and the food is beyond disgusting. Nothing like at the other resorts I have stayed in, in the past. When I travel I do all inclusive because I like not have to worry about anything But not at this hotel! I went to dinner asked got a glass of moscato wine they told me that would be an "up charge" I asked for a shrimp tempera roll at the sushi place they told me that was an "up charge" .... never have I experience anything like this at any other all-inclusive hotel....  as for my friends wedding they didn't give her the food that she originally thought she was getting,  we pretty much ate the same thing that they offered at the buffet, the wedding planner we awful, she was late  not attentive, not organized, just awful. Please don't waste your money coming here.

findings.title: Carl H. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
Absolutely loved this place. Great all inclusive resort with great dinning and awesome pools and beach. Daily activities and the alcohol upgrade is fantastic with a huge variety of Anejo rums from Havana club from Cuba to top notch whiskeys.
For the price can't stay at a more beautiful place

findings.title: Antonio Q. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Great resort, specialty restaurants were great. I would not recommend the buffet style restaurant. Food was bland but you can get a quick meal there. Alcohol through the resort is crazy. Beach is awesome and the beach water/waitresses are amazing. Rooms were decent.. a little dated but not like some of the other places I have seen. Oh, and I got my money's worth at the bar ;-) Andres kept em' coming!!

findings.title: Crystal C. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
I actually really enjoyed my stay here. I stayed here for 2 days and here's how it went down: 
Check in was soooooooooo long it took maybe an hour to check in which is ridiculous and they should work on making checking in more efficient! After check in, we headed to our hotel room and it had a beautiful view, the suite wasn't that nice there was a king sized bed and Thiery mugler shampoo and all but the room could've looked a lot better. Aside from that, the inside of the hotel is BEAUTIFUL. Vines drape down from everywhere and the hotel is so tall and huge there are actually 6 pyramid thingies and each of them have a lot of suites. The food and drinks were all-inclusive. The drinks were amazing, the food is good but could be better, and there's a lot of entertainment too which is awesome. There's a club at night which I had a decent time at. The pools are my favorite part they are huge and the beach is right behind it. Your jaw will drop when you see the view of the beach... it's simply amazing. Overall, I had an amazing time here and would love to come here again!

findings.title: Holly V. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
truthfully, i will be back! i cant believe i have never tried out these "inclusive vacations" before! the staffs are all so friendly and very attentive. before the vacation, i was yelping this place and a lot of yelpers were saying that we should get the upgrade to royal. since we had kids going along with us, we couldnt. i felt like i didnt really miss anything. i LOVED everything about this hotel, from the hotel to the water. EVERYTHING WAS PERFECT.

first of, make sure you make reservations with FUEGO (i believe this is latin fusion) and ENZO (asian fusion). BANA isnt so great.. its sushi but the american kind of sushi and the fish is pretty warm by the time you try to finish it.. BUT!! NAOS (buffet) is always available if your dinner isnt so great.

BRING YOUR KIDS (they have a daycare that does a lot of activities & they feed your kids too!)

findings.title: Zohrab G. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
Nice place,okey food, but Service is very slow and comparing it with rest of the resorts, this place has lots of restrictions.
Package we got it all inclusive but they charge extra for some drinks.
I don't recommend this place if your like to drink and smoke.

findings.title: Gaby A. (5/5)
findings.snippet: My husband and I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun for our honeymoon and we had a blast! We were greeted by staff members and when we arrived in our room, they laid out red rose petals in the shape of a heart on the bed with champagne in an ice bucket!! You can't get much better than that! The best part about this resort is the staff! They all deserve 5+ stars for their service. They were always very polite, courteous  and accommodating. Darwin and Carlos made our experience at Bana(best restaurant at the resort) magical! Darwin remembered us and Carlos made us a dragon fruit dessert. Also the pool bartender, Sal, was great. The staff always made sure we were having a great time. The resort itself is beautiful with green vines from the top of the resort hanging down. The food was also very good. Such a different variety. The pool, beach and rooms were very clean. We had a turn down service every night which was nice. Overall we had a great experience and can't wait to return!

findings.title: Nicole T. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Love, Love, LOVE the Paradisus Cancun! My husband and I visited here for a week April 2016. We flew from JFK on a direct flight, and spent the entire week in straight paradise! The service, food and atmosphere couldn't have been better! The food was delicious, the staff bent over backwards to do everything they could for us. We would visit again to The Paradisus Cancun or it's many other Melia Hotels around the Carribean soon!

findings.title: Cheryl B. (4/5)
findings.snippet: Its only because of the wedding I attended here and my past stay when this was the Melia Cancun that I am giving this hotel 4 stars!! They did an excellent job on the wedding but we did have some hiccups with check-in as there system broke and I don't think that they were as prepared as they should have been! Asking people to pay double for a room and wait for a refund is not professional.  Additionally, the air in the room was in need of constant repair!  I mean you want to get off the beach and out of the heat.. you want to do that .... going back to a hot room was not the cool thing to do.  The Expedia Team at this hotel sucks! They booked return trips for us and the rides never showed up.... The hotel was very accommodating and requested taxi transportation to for us back to the airport.... and I say accommodating because we had one of the first flights out and we left the hotel at 4am! Food was great no complaints and the staff was good as well.  If it wasn't for the fabulous wedding I would have rated them 2.5 to 3 stars.

findings.title: Andrew D. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
After reading the reviews I was a little worried about staying at this hotel. When we arrived we were greeted with a heavenly floral scent. It was quite strong but so welcoming! We were initially booked with regular suite with lagoon view. We upgraded to the royal service for a bit more a night and were given an ocean view room for free. Royal service was so worth the money!! We were literally treated like royalty. The exclusive pool, restaurant, buffet, and adults only section were OUTSTANDING. Staff really made this trip incredible, we saw the same friendly faces throughout our stay and were greeted with "nice to see you again". the restaurants were pretty great for being an all inclusive hotel. One con is that after a few days, all of the food sort of tasted the same regardless of the restaurant. But all in all we were never hungry, they kept our fridge stocked with beer, drinks, and snacks. There was the handy Royal service buffet with food, and a full bar for you to make your own drinks. There was literally no way I could even begin to be slightly hungry. The lobby does not have air conditioning but it wasn't ridiculously hot inside. The air conditioner in our hotel room didn't work as amazing as we hoped it would, but we didn't stay in our hotel room very long anyway. We rode the bus to downtown for shopping, the buses were clean and not as scary as you would think. WOW shopping for tourists is so ridiculously pricey!! $15 for a baby shirt, you really need to haggle them on pricing because they up charge so much. The nightlife really is jut like Vegas!! It was so much fun!! Really had a blast!! 

Anyway, all in all it was an amazing trip we highly recommend this hotel to all.

findings.title: Jason G. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
We loved the Paradisus Cancun Resort! The staff culture of this resort is 5 Star, and everyone made us feel welcome from the reception desk to the Timeshare presentation, bartenders, restaurant staff, Pool Staff, House keepers. We never felt like we were treated badly at all. Before we came we read all of the reviews to know what we were in for, and I have to let you know if you are like me, and read reviews, the food is amazing! Don't believe the bland comments. There are many restaurants to choose from and they're all great, including the buffet. Everyone is helpful getting you booked, excursions, dinner reservations, directions, taxi, room service, where is this, where is that, the staff is amazing!
Check-in they offered us the royal service, which gives you access to the boring side of the resort for stuffy old people, 2 extra restaurants that looked snobby, and a small portion of the pool without kids. I would have only preferred the pool portion as I find that parents trying to teach their crying kids how to swim on my vacation is very tacky and needs to happen in a backyard somewhere, and not a resort. So the private pool would have been nice but not for an extra $45.00 per person, per day. Overall we chose to not upgrade to Royal service and didn't regret that decision at all. This resort is freaking awesome already and Royal service wasn't necessary in my view.
As an RCI member we were given an owners suite and it was beautiful, the staff recognized us the whole trip as owners, based on our wrist band, and treated us as such. Even outside of the resort, in town and excursions the locals recognized us as Club Melia and it made us feel special. Paradisus carries a big weight in town even the shuttle driver took us back first, to get a bigger tip.
FYI - Make sure you drink lots of water and electrolytes as my wife had heat exhaustion and almost had a stroke due to the heat and drinking alcohol with not enough water, drink lots of water & electrolytes. 

Pros -  Drinks are not watered down, Food at all restaurants is great and over abundant, Staff bends over backwards for you, room A/C works great, resort is beautiful, Staff is very professional, everyone speaks English, beach is super clean, Ocean is not cold at all, pool towels are big and fluffy, timeshare presentation wasn't pushy and obnoxious, daily entertainment was good quality, housekeepers didn't steal money left out on accident, they kept our room very clean and nice.

Cons - Hard to think of any but I have to be honest and subjective,  Humidity, The only A/C in the resort is in your room & restaurants, The currency exchange (Dollar for Peso) is lower in the resort than on the streets, shops in the resort don't take dollars, the clothing gift shop ripped us off, energy drinks aren't included in the "all-Inclusive"

findings.title: Cathy M. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
Oh my gosh. I am writing this review from my hotel room right now. This is our third night and I don't normally care to complain but I am so disgusted that I have to warn others. The food here is DISGUSTING! Absolutely horrendous, sickening. It looks amazing at first glance but leaves one racing to vomit immediately. The way they cook their meat in the buffet area is super unsanitary and everything is left super oily and tasteless.  Also, good luck getting a good drink at the bar. They water down all the liquor bottles, so you'll never get a good buzz, just a bunch of sugary bs. I'll give two stars because the staff is super nice and the beach is still amazing.  But the AC in the hotel is so shot and even sitting in the lounge areas can be miserable.  Be prepared to be dripped on by the AC Vents during breakfast, lunch, and dinner.  Lastly- the pool bar closes at 6pm- highly disappointing for a pool and beach resort. 

Check out the picture below. This is the "pizza" served at the glamorous Market Grill at lunch today. We waited an entire HOUR for pizza that looks like a toddler made in her easy-bake-oven!!! Why this took an entire hour, I haven't a clue. I now know what heated cardboard taste like. Thank you, Paradisus cancun!

findings.title: Erick S. (1/5)
findings.snippet: The manager Veronica is very rude and disrespectful does not like taking care of her customers

findings.title: Destiny B. (4/5)
findings.snippet: This was a great resort. We spent the extra money for the royal service option and it was money well spent. Our butler Rosanna was great, as well as the other staff that we encountered during our trip. The food was so so, nothing spectacular but there are several options so we were not disappointed. The resort was clean and smells amazing... Like lavender and green tea every where you turn. The Bali beds are a must and included if you choose the Royal service option. Spa services are great, do yourself a favor and treat yourself while you are there. I would give this place 5 stars but we were locked out of our room each day for some reason so that was a pain. Overall, I would stay here again.

findings.title: Gen C. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
Pros & Cons to Paradisus Cancun Resort


Pros:
* The resort is beautifully constructed and decorated 
* The staff are friendly and super polite
* The staff definitely try to get you to drink as much alcohol as possible
* There was an Amstar desk in the resort to schedule excursions through
* The sand is white and the ocean is clear turquoise blue
* There was a "Family Concierge" person upon check in that explained how the resorts    work
* Room service was free
* Top shelf liquor selection included 


Cons:
* It is extremely humid inside the resort. There are a ton of plants and fountains with a glass pyramid ceiling, which, with the lack of air conditioning, creates a greenhouse effect. Bad hair day every day.

* The bars or lounges were sooooo humid, we could not stand being in them to drink. We spent most of our nights in our room where there was air conditioning. 

* We paid for a Junior Suite with Lagoon View room. All that could be seen from the window was a building. When we complained, they said if we go out on the porch and peek around the corner, we can see the lagoon.

* Don't go expecting not to bring additional money. Everywhere you try to sit outside costs additional money. We finally gave in one day and paid for the cabana. It normally cost $140 USD for the day, but they cut us a deal for $80 and threw in a free bottle of tequila as a present.  The waiter brought us drinks and food all day which was pleasant. I don't usually drink alcohol, so my tolerance is low. I had 7 double shot pina coladas and was not even buzzed at all.

* We were on floor 0 of pyramid 4. The corridor right outside our room was set up for breakfast and cocktails for people with special gold bands. We were not allowed to partake. The annoying part was that it woke me up at 6:30 every morning when they were setting up breakfast and then there were constantly people congregating outside our room door.

* All of the restaurants, except two, within the resort require reservations that have to be made a day in advance. So upon arrival, you have the choice between sweating in a taco restaurant called Blue Agave that is super humid, but yummy, or a buffet restaurant called Naos, which wasn't that great. Actually, I wasn't overly impressed with the food at any of the restaurants.

* The bed was hard

* Being on floor 0, you cannot simply walk across all 5 pyramids in the resort across floor 0. We had to constantly walk up to floor one to cross over the restaurants and then back down to floor 0 again. 

* We did a snorkeling excursion through Cancun Sailing to Isla Mujeres. It was fun, but all of the coral looked dead. The Amstar guy said we shouldn't have booked it through Cheapcarribean.com when we booked our resort stay because it wasn't the greatest snorkeling. What can I say, he was definitely right. Unfortunately, the excursions are non-refundable. I recommend waiting to book excursions until you get to the resort and can talk to the Amstar guys who are local rather than a customer service representative at cheapcarribean.com who doesn't really know.

findings.title: Cheri C. (1/5)
findings.snippet: I have never been to cancun and will never waste money here again. The hotel is beautiful, but that is all it is. Drinks are watered down, good thing we brought our own vodka to add to the cranberry juice. Food was horrible. Everything for breakfast was either full of grease or was cold. Toast took me 6 times through the machine to even slightly brown. Dinner - joke. At Mole, i ordered chicken, it came out pale white! couldnt eat it. They took our apps away before we were finished because the dinner was coming. Enzo - we ordered our dinner at the same time as apps, 30 min after our apps, waiter asked if we were ready to order.. duh.. already did that an hour ago, he brought out the food, but forgot my rice. Took 30 min for that to arrive then my food was cold. So gross. Only good food was Market Grill for dinner. Then we had a run in at the pool with 2 ladies. They convinced the worker that we stole their chairs, but we didnt. They were empty when we got there. They allowed them to stay and moved us somewhere with no shade and kids splashing. Told us if we took a 90 min tour they would give is 50% off massage.. thats the same story we were hounded with the entire time. These women harrassed us the entire time we stayed there, they went out of their way to walk by us, call us names, point and laugh, the staff did nothing. Turned out they were part of a wedding party, so obviously we meant nothing to the hotel. Well the hotel sucks and staff is so rude. Dont waste your time or money. go somewhere else. I have never wanted a vacation to end until this time. btw, i saved a woman in the ocean because the lifeguards were too busy talking to each other, she was panicked and her daughter had called for their help, but they werent coming, i went back out there to get her myself.

findings.title: Sam K. (3/5)
findings.snippet:
We stayed between 8/10-8/15 and we had great time. We had little 3 year old so we decided to choose a hotel with all inclusive. We were not offered any upgrade options, but this hotel has few things that are available only to who pays more money for upgrades. Also there is 1 restaurant that is not included in the all inclusive package. Few restaurants have optional paid entrees. 

Room:
We had ocean view room in main building (#3). The first room we checked in had recent ceiling repair and whatever they used to patch the ceiling fell on to my wife's head, then fell to the floor. Since we have a hole in the ceiling and stuff on the floor, we went to front desk to exchange room. The rep exchanged it for us, but there was no apology from the management. We are used to Las Vegas hotels, so we felt that rooms were little outdated, but has everything you need. Mini refrigerator is stocked with beverages and snacks. Lighting is mix of LED and fluorescent lights. It was little noisy at night because main building has music through out the hall. It was convenient to get to restaurants and shops.

Main building:
We booked this hotel, because it has a lot of plants and looks like a jungle which is really cool. It has bonds and fish. Bars, coffee shop, gift shops, restaurants. Mac computers in the front desk room although they did not use Ethernet cable and use Wifi. Elevators were kind of slow and unpredictable. Many times, we encountered cleaning guy inside the elevator who rides with us.     

Spa:
It is way over priced. 50 minutes for $145. We got massage just because we got $200 complimentary coupon. They have sauna, Jacuzzi which they call it hydro therapy that is included in the massage. It may be an option on rainy days. Only takes credit card and no cash.

Pool & Beach:
Beach has strong waves so it is not for small children. There is no life guard around, so you need to be extra careful with small children. There were empty chairs on the beach so we always could use the chairs, but it was more difficult around the pool. There was a drink server who took our orders, but very slow

Staffs:
Generally, everyone was very nice. Front desk & phone operators all spoke great English. Some are laid back and others are eager to serve you and appreciate extra tip.

Show:
We really liked the show that starts at 8:30pm. Seating is very limited, so we had to either stand up or sit on the side. Those shows are actually very good and entertaining for free. Since, we did not have much to do in the evening, it was great way to be entertained. They have drink servers during the show

Drink: Only Sol and Tecate beers are available. Mixed drinks were very light on alcohol. 

Food: Food was ok. They look better than what they taste. We tried all except Fuego and Tempo(Paid). All restaurants require sleeve shirt for men. 

Baby Club/Kids Club: Our daughter was under 4 so she was put in the baby club. There are a lot of toys and they have movie playing. Our daughter was not comfortable left there alone so we stayed with her. There are 3 chairs in the front, and when there are not many other kids around, they let one parent stay with the kid in the play area.  

Location: It is 5km away from shops and main area. We did not venture out since we were told that taxi will not be available on the way back and did not want to use the bus. Next time, I would like to stay in the main area for convenience. 

This is the only hotel we have stayed so we cannot compare, but we met few people who have come to Cancun many times, and they said that this hotel is nice. The hotel was family friendly.

findings.title: Christina S. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
If I had to rate the stay by just the hotel itself it would be a 5/5 hands down! I myself live in Las Vegas so touristy stuff doesn't really impress me anymore. The Royal Service team truly try to make your stay the best as possible. We arrived a bit early in the morning and check in wasn't until 3 pm, luckily, the Royal Service staff was able to have room service clean a recent check out and let us enter the room at 10 am. Our personal butler was Rode, if you can, try to get him. On our last night, he left roses in a shape of a heart on our bed after we got back from dinner. Adorable. No stress what so ever. The rooms were beautiful, just as pictured on their website. The pool and beach area was to die for, I wish I had more time to relax at the beach. The view from the patio was awesome. Free room service! (Don't forget to tip the guys though!) And at night, it was silent with just the waves crashing at the shore, very peaceful. (We had some friends who didn't get the Royal Service and apparently they could hear the bar music through out the entire night.) All the drinks were on point. I regret not drinking more....Hahaha. 

Overall. I can't say anything bad about the service I received while staying at the hotel with the Royal Service. 

Best eats were definitely at Tempo and Vento. Tempo is not included in the all inclusive package, but $50 dollars for a 10 course meal is a steal from a Michelin Star chef. the bar area in the Royal Service had a very nice selection through out the day and night. They also have a bartender on staff at all times in that area and even offer to bring up full bottles of liquor to your room at no charge. 

Now to the Cons....

-Yhi Spa was a huge let down. When I arrived, my butler asked me if he could make any appointments for me during my stay. I asked for a manicure, pedicure and for my hair to be curled for the wedding. When the butler called, it sounded like the Yhi front office staff was being sassy about the appointment. Eventually he got them to book an appointment for 2 pm the next day. When I arrived 10 mins early for my appointment, apparently, they had never put in the system for a mani or pedi, just hair styling. The first front desk lady stops talking to me, and then walks away, so then a second lady tried to help me. She charges me $85 dollars USD, I don't question it and go on my merry way. Two ladies come out and lead me to a secluded area and neither of them spoke English. But I had my google translate with me, so I could talk to them about what I wanted. 10 mins in, the first lady who walked away from me at the front desk enters and asks me "Well, did you want a Spa Mani/Pedi or did you just want a change of color? I asked her what the difference was and she said the change of color did not include doing the cuticles/cutting the nail or filing them down. I picked change of color, because I did not want them to charge me even more money...... Then 15 mins later, the second front desk lady comes in saying she forgot tot charge me for my hair styling too.... I'm just like whatever. However, the employees who did my hair and nails did a fantastic job. In no way do I blame them for the mishap, but the incompetent front desk . When I left, they charged me an additional $25 dollars for the hair style. When I went back up to the room, while reviewing the price chart, they had charged me the Yhi Spa Mani/Pedi price of $85 originally. I was a little bit pissed, but I was getting ready for a wedding, and I didn't feel like fighting with the front office staff. Not really the hotel's fault though, just poor management at the Spa.

-Most of the Dinner Restaurants are..... bland. The first night we went to Fuego and our whole party was not impressed. Even the wedding food that the hotel provided was very bland.... 

But once again, other then the weird miscommunication at Yhi Spa, the hotel is to die for! I was in heaven the 4 nights I stayed in the Royal Service Suites. Like literally... just pay the couple extra dollars per night to be pampered! You will not forget it! I will be staying here again in the future when I bring my family!

findings.title: Veronica T. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
Perfect well deserved Vacation

This resort its a relly good deal, we had a lot of fun, we were a party of three my sister my 3yr old daughter and my self, there was plenty of activities for all 3 of us and had a amazing expirience, there were however a few cons, lets make a list with the bad first

CONS
-(probably the most important) There is no A/C inside the resort
       If feels really humid inside because the lack of AC, however you DO have an AC unit in your room

- a reservation HAS to be made at least a day before to dine at the restaurants (excluding the buffet)

- the phone operators can be a little rude, for trying to finish up with your call in a fast manner

PROS

- Plenty of food choices, the buffet its really a great option for the whole day, everything here is delicious, the meats, Perfectly done every time.

-Pool entratainmet every day at the main pool

-waiters very nice, and fast with service

-kids activities very interactive and fun

Every night they offer two shows inside  the hotel one at 6pm ( by Bana) and another one at 8pm (inside the avenue Bar) wich is very entretaining, our room very clean and spacious, also I used the babyclub once and I was very happy to see that my daughter had a good time everyone there very well trained to interact with kids.

The YHI spa was AMAZING! it has a lovely hydromassage pool with diferent stations to trigger diferent areas, I highly recomend that if you schedule a massage ro get there about an hour befofe to enjoy,  the spa, our  massage therapist was amazing she work on my problem areas and has extremely happy with her.

Overall a great Resort, all inclusive worry free and even tough its a Time share hotel, there are not pushy at all to go join the club.

Defenetly going back next year!

findings.title: Holly G. (2/5)
findings.snippet: Stayed there in 2013. Loved it so went back big mistake! Stayed 6 nights 3 out of the 6 I was awaken by drilling and hammering that was at 4am the other 2 times was 6am the cleaning staff were going around collecting room service silverware and platters. I went down stairs to discuss with concierge after the 2nd time. I was made to feel like a liar! The person behind the desk Alejandro was condescending and practically called me a liar no services or remodeling is preformed before 9am. So the next time it happened it was 6am I got out of bed and took a picture showed it to front desk still no resolution and was made to feel like an inconvenience and a nuisance. At this point I just wanted to leave it was a horrible experience one does not go on vacation to get startled out of bed at dawn 3 times out of 6 . After I returned home I emailed a Anelica (quality manager)  she told me that never happened! And that a manager came up with me to check on the noise and there was nothing going on!!! She and who ever told her that is not being  truthful .. Never again!!

findings.title: Jenni L. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Paradisus was a phenomenal resort to stay. My partner and I booked the royal service package which provided a lot more privilege in the resort (i.e., butler service [our butler was Juan and he was just a sweetheart], room service, private snack and alcohol areas just for Royal service and many more). Our butler practically did mainly all our stuff for us within the resort from confirming and booking our dinner reservation, booking our cabanas and every time we would enter our room he always arranged different surprise petal trails in our room after coming back from being outside. It made our vacation more romantic. Food was not bad at all. My partner and I tried (Naos, La Palapa, Tempo and Fuego) which were all good to us. Our room was so exquisite (we got the ocean view Jr. Suite) which was breath taking to wake up to every morning. We are definitely coming back and I highly recommend to book for the Royal Service.

findings.title: Elly N. (5/5)
findings.snippet: The most beautiful All inclusive resort we have been to and worth every penny. It really is heaven on earth. The grounds, the staff, the rooms, the restaurants and so on. Everything was so beautiful and so perfect. The food variety and all the choices that we had was so great. We had the best time and will absouloutly go back there again.

findings.title: Mitri H. (2/5)
findings.snippet: I wish I could have given this place a better rating but Paradisus (along with Cancun in general) need to start providing better service and food to their tourists. Lets start with the check in process: getting the room we requested was an ordeal. They were not available and then trying to find a suitable alternative was difficult. Part of the issue is the employees are not sufficiently versed in English (I know its not their language) but its a major resort with tons of English speaking travelers. Second, the room was spacious and clean. Some in my party had insufficient AC issues but I was on floor 1 (room 2112) and it remained cool. The room has a mini bar which they keep things like: soda, beer, candy, juices, and water. They are supposed to fill it up every day but they don't (service tended to be inconsistent). If you tip which is what I recommend then you could end up with a flowing amount of goodies. All of it was free. The lobby and hallways of the hotel were very warm. I am not sure why. After a day or so I got used to it. Overall the hotel was clean. Food: huge disappointment. Reservations to the individual restaurants were a hassle. Again I had to tip to get in last minute.Food was mediocre. While there are a variety of options, think of a cheap buffet. It was not horrible but it could be much better. Alcohol: plenty of it and I was able to get some top shelf drinks for free. Pool was big and clean. Easy access to the beach. Overall: service was just not consistent, food wasn't that good, and I just felt that you had to tip to just get basic services (which I do not mind tipping but should be for great service and not just to get something basically done). Tips: I like using 100 pesos as a means of tipping (thats almost $5); tip the general manager at the restaurants like $20 and you can probably get in without a prior reservation; Wifi worked in the resort so use Google translator if you need to; eat outside the hotel if you want a really nice dinner. We went to a high end Lobster place and had an excellent meal.

findings.title: Nancy H. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
I'm a travel agent and most likely will never sell this property again.  I personally stayed at Paradisus in July 2016 with my family and 20 others that included kids and adults. I had the family concierge room and it was a joke.  Nothing really extra and my butler was horrible.  I called to the hotel every week for 4 months confirming and making sure of the rooms and dinner restaurants were correct.  Well when I get there my room wasn't ready until 5:00 then I had a room with ONE bed and no pull out sofa then they ran me around the resort looking at one other room that smelled like mold.  The food was ok and the breakfast wasn't good at all.  The majority of the staff speak NO English so it was very difficult to even get a wash cloth.  The house keeping only put 
ONE wash cloth in our bathroom daily and never took the dirty ones off the floor. Everyday I had to call several times for more wash clothes and towels.  Then informed them that my sink was clogged no one never came to fix it.  My other guest had issues as well.  
JUST WANT TO SAY, stay away from this 
3 star property...

findings.title: Toya T. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Royal Service is a must! Negative reviews are from people without it!  Trust me.... it's worth the extra $$$! Your own private butler, Bali Beds, ALL top shelf alcohol, private pool, private beach, exclusive restaurants for Royal Service guests only. If you're going to pay for a vacation.... Pay for a VACATION! Special Thank you to our butler Sergio, Ediel and Eddie at La Palapa, Javier at Blue Agave, and Cindy at the Royal Service Bar. They offered the most AMAZING service!!

findings.title: Darren A. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
Paradisus Cancun
 Jun 21, 2016
Amazing all inclusive! Stay on the royal/adult only side
We stayed in June 2016 for 6 nights. Weather was perfect even though it was reporting thunderstorms all week (we had rain for one afternoon). We stayed on the adult only side of the hotel in the royal service area. These are both HIGHLY RECOMMENDED! The hotel (cheapcaribean.com) did provide us with some vouchers as they advertised $1500 but these were just lots of small vouchers offering $50 off massage etc. Royal Service: The royal service includes a 'butler'. This is an assigned service person who will usually find you each day - sometimes at your room, sometimes see you at breakfast or the pool. He booked all our restaurant reservations (all but 2 restaurants need res). He also booked our cabanas by the pool for us. With royal service you get 2 cabanas per room per stay guaranteed - these are excellent and worth doing! Towels are included by the pool as to is sunscreen (which it seems you put on there by the pool). Our butler was Juan who was excellent! We didnt really take advantage of this all that much though to be honest. Breakfast was excellent! In the royal service there was a separate section where theres a help yourself bar! This bar has beers, champagne, wine and lots of good liquor - grey goose, good tequilas, hendricks etc...they are not watered down and yuo can make the drinks yourself or there is someone there offering help and suggestions- this yelp yourself is ONLY in the royal service. Other areas had bars that you ask for the drinks and they make for you - they are just as good and same liquors etc but they make them for you. The breakfast in the royal service was more like a mini buffet...eggs bene, sausages, breads and very good fresh fruits! (better fruits here that other area). Showers were the huge rain head showers. Balcony was nice and big (shame only one lounge chair and one normal chair) - would have enquired about room upgrade for Ocean view but the back (where we were) was just overlooking the tennis court. Private balconies with only the one above having a slight chance of seeing you. Restaurants: There are about 6-8 restaurants - 1 is paid because itsa 2x Michelin Star restaurant. All others are included: all of these are reservation except 2 which are buffets. Book your reservation 1 day in advance - the butler helps you with this. Recommended restaurants were: mole (Mx), fuego (Asian Fusion), Bana (Sushi), Grill Mrkt (was good for the brazilian night). not preferred restaurant: Cant remember name but was a taco place. Was Ok. Beach: beach is amazing! Aqua coloured water about 3 feet from the hotel - has many parasols on the beach - help yourself and there were enough of them - they have service guys bringing around waters and drinks too on the beach! Amazing! Bars: They have 2 main bars with 1 being a night club - was excellent fun! Entertainment: They have some entertainment each night at the Avenue Bar. They have a volleyball court on the beach and a couple of times per week there were entertainment guys there and just welcoming you to join in - fun. We did try and go to some of the events such as the how to make guacamole and there was just no one there at the time/place it was scheduled - not end of the world. Excursions/trips: We went with CheapCaribbean/Amstar and just found our rep (they are all in the same location on the 2nd floor) - these guys have all the trips and book it all up. We did 2: Xplor - this was ATVs, Zip Lining, Cave Swimming, Cave Rafting - for about $150 US. This was good fun but A LOT of people. Very touristy. We queued a little to get the zip lines and only just had enough time to do all the events. I loved it but be prepared to have a lot of tourists and a little waiting. Cave Swimming was the best. ATVs were OK. Zips was excellent - thru 2 waterfalls and a slide! 2nd trip: Chichen Itza Plus tour - about $107 (due to booked 2 tours at once). This is RECOMMENDED. It was with GoMexico. The initial checkin process to get onto the main coach that took us took about an hour and a bit of a hassle - but worth it once you have checked in and got boarding passes. Recommended hotel? Absolutely if you go royal service! This was a lovely place and what an all inclusive should be about. Tips: Bring lots of $1 US bills rather than large notes...you dont feel you have to tip but we felt like we wanted to a lot more than we could because we didnt have enough small bills. For 6 nights I wish we had about $30-$40 just for the hotel stay so prob best to leave these bills at the hotel, then out at night or by the pool just take 10 or so with you. US dollars are all good to use! Towels provided with a pool bag that you take take off site (and return). Towels by the pool too.
Helpful

findings.title: Shaliza M. (5/5)
findings.snippet: It was my first time in cancun and I stayed here  it was simply amazing the service the food the top shelf drinks they really went all out to ensure you were treated like royalty the pools were beautiful and clean and who can complain about staying right on the beach the ocean was so close it didn't even feel as if I left the hotel and when they say all inclusive they mean it anything you want and need they have it waiting ready for you in no time the customer service was A++ and I don't even speak Spanish I will defiantly recommend this place to anyone it's away from the party scene but the true definition of a vacation relaxing environment with just the right amount of guest so you don't feel like it's over crowded and you can enjoy your stay.

findings.title: Ni V. (3/5)
findings.snippet:
We had a great time at this resort! The employees are so hard working. The room was huge and spotless. The pyramid did give a sorta strange shalt to the room however we were never really in the room so no biggie to us. The restaurants excellent! Service was good. Highly entertaining! Loved the cold rags we get when we arrived after a sweaty day! I loved all the restaurants at the hotel except for the Japenese. I think they must have been having an off night when we went though.
There are a few ways this resort can improve:
1.  The atrium makes the hotel very humid. Ahh Sweating bullets!
2.  The cabanas were only for the "Melia Club". I would have loved an opportunity to sit in them for $400. a night. 
3. The reason why this review is a three star and not a four star caan be blamed on the woman in check out at front desk.. Our vacation was fabulous until we found a cell phone on the beach. I didn't want to leave it there so I brought to front desk. When arriving they said we would need to bring back in the morning because lost and found was closed. My husband and eight year old brought the phone back in the morning and were able to turn it into lost and found. A few days later when checking out the lady who checked us out accused us of keeping the phone, she then was talking to security and telling us she didn't believe that we turned it in because only her and another girl were working when we turned it in. She at that point told us she would be reviewing the cameras. We encouraged her to do just that however were quite offended that she kept dragging it out. When getting to the airport we also had problems there boarding and I am not sure if she called the airport but it seamed like she had. Not exactly what you want to be going through in another country and especially Mexico! It was upsetting and nerve racking. I learned my lesson that if I ever were to see anthers belongings in another country its probably best to leave it. I think the idea should be that we should be innocent until found guilty but this is mexico and it is more like you are guilty until you prove your innocent!

findings.title: Christopher W. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
The Melia Paradisus Cancun was a relatively mediocre resort (especially for the price) that overpowers you with perfume being pumped through the ventilation system.
There were four of us total, two couples, that stayed over 5 days. Overall it was a nice experience, ok food (Blue Agave was the only really good restaurant), and fun bartenders/wait staff. We enjoyed ourselves, but probably will not return.

There was only one major complaint: when we arrived at the resort we were asked if we wanted rooms next to each other and we said sure, thinking it would be easier for making plans together. They happily gave us our rooms, and when we entered we realized we had been given "Lagoon View" when we had already paid for "Beach View". When we asked customer service for help they rudely ushered us to the front desk, who in turn said they would do nothing. Management also said we would not receive a refund for the difference in room price and that we should just be happy with our rooms. They had beach view rooms available, and we only wanted the rooms we paid for and didn't really care if they were next to each other. We were ready to unpack and start our vacation. Management at Paradisus turned a simple switch, into a representation of poor customer service.

findings.title: Brian K. (3/5)
findings.snippet:
Paradisus Cancun is a decent Cancun strip hotel in Hotel Zone in Cancun, Mexico.
It was located near the airport, which takes 30 minutes by car.
The hotel was well maintained and staffs were mostly friendly.
The reasons of three stars are the followings.
1. Dinner appointment in certain restaurants is almost impossible to get unless you book them upon your arrival. Plan ahead.
2. Reception staff's incompetence. Specifically requested quiet room for my 2-year old daughter in advance and at time of check in, still gave us a room next to night club which you can literally feel the vibrations due to the music till 3am in the morning.

 Besides these issues, we had a great time there eating and swimming most of our stays.

findings.title: Nikki L. (2/5)
findings.snippet: BEWARE this hotel is extremely hot during the day and  through out the night!! My husband suffered a heat stroke twice during our stay. If you think after spending your day out in the sun and expecting some relief inside you'll be disappointed.  I am one of 9 families that booked this hotel and let me tell you that the heat inside is unbearable to enjoy their evening events and shows. Don't get me wrong the hotel is beautiful  but there should be some type of air circulation and breeze .A fan or two would be nice to keep place more enjoyable for evening shows and activities. I find that the only place with the best air conditioning is in your room. I wanted to comment about my friend (Phi) on  the previous post. The treament we recieved from this one staff member was unacceptable. I hope these reviews are helpful for your hotel in bettering the hospitality and treament of your guests. I have to say kudos to Enrique in accommodating our group of 32 people for Vento restaurant tonight.

findings.title: Phi N. (1/5)
findings.snippet: This is my 9th time in Cancun, and this hotel is the worst one I've ever stayed at. The head waiter in the buffet disrespected our kids and I didn't find out till the next day when he tried to disrespect me and my group.  I really don't know what his issue is with Asians but he expects us to know how everything works at this hotel. There are always two sides to the story, so I just want to get to the point with the situation. Instead of kicking the kids (ages 15-20) out of the restaurant, he could have just explaned to them how the buffet works and in my situation,  he can just ask the hostess to see if she  let us in and then confront us, but NOOO this guy just came over and tried to throw us out of our table.  My point is the hostess showed us our table and he came over and tried to make us leave.  I'm writing this review  at four o'clock in the morning on my vacation because of how mad  I was and lost my sleep over the incident  .  To the management team, if you're reading this, I don't want your apology because it is too late.  I believe the staff needs to be trained to prevent any incidents from happening in the first place.

findings.title: Bh N. (4/5)
findings.snippet: We came as a family of 6, including two toddlers to cancun for very first time. The highlight of this hotel is the service that each and every worker has provided us. People at the hotel are extremely helpful and willing to accommodate our special request since one of our kids is extremely picky with food. The hotel is very well maintained with a good amount of staff constantly cleaning the premises.  Our rooms were spacious, except the TV is a bit small.  There are plenty of hut/chairs for use at the beach, but it was more challenging to find chairs at the pool area unless we go there earlier in the morning to get the chairs.  The food selection is average, not much of big selection on seafood nor exotic tropical fruits.  Overall, we enjoyed our stay at Paradisus and would recommend this place.

findings.title: Shavonda S. (3/5)
findings.snippet:
Me & the hubs decided to do a quick anniversary weekend getaway to Cancun and stayed at this resort. To be a 27 year old property, it was very well kept and offered your typical amenities that you expect from the Paradisus hotel brand (we previously stayed at Paradisus Punta Cana as well). However, what I didn't necessarily care for was how inconvenient it was to walk throughout the hotel. I felt like we climbed up and down stairs all weekend long just to get from one side of the hotel to the other. It became rather annoying at times, but we just went with the flow. The other big bummer was the food offered at this resort. I remember when we stayed at Paradisus Punta Cana that the food wasn't that great either, but this place was just a true disappointment - including the restaurant food. The beach, pool, gym, and spa were all nice. 

So I'm that girl that works out even on vacay and I must say that the gym facilities blew me away! It had a cardio room, a spin/cycle room, and a studio! After a having a great workout, I typically like to cool down in the whirlpool/sauna/etc. Wasn't able to do that this go round, because all those amenities were located in the spa area and were not accessible without paying a whopping 35 bucks. Blah.Thankfully, I was able to access all of it when I went and got a massage. Speaking of which, if you get a massage - ask for Lu Lu!!! She is excellent with her hands! For a quick weekend getaway, this place satisfied us tired wore out parents. Now would I stay at this resort again? Probably not.

findings.title: Krystal L. (5/5)
findings.snippet: I can't say enough good things about paradisus cancun! We just came back June 16th and none of us wanted to leave! We went for my husbands 30th with a group of friends and it was amazing! The food was great blue agave was delicious for lunch!! Fuego was amazing and vento was amazing as well! The buffet had a nice variety of food! Just make sure you call and make reservations very early the day before  because a lot of the places get booked very quickly even calling the morning of was too late for us because the only times they had available were 9 or 10pm reservations. It was pretty easy getting a chair on the beach the pool was too warm for us so the beach was the perfect place to be! The hotel smells amazing everywhere you go everyone is so helpful and nice! The rooms   Are nice and clean and the beds are actually comfortable! I know everyone wants a beach view but We got the lagoon view and it was beautiful the sunset was incredible!  Tip well and they'll treat you even better! Were already planning our next trip back to paradisus and we're making it a yearly tradition now from the great experience we had!!

findings.title: Tammy B. (5/5)
findings.snippet: We love this hotel so much we're headed back for our 3rd time in Sept! Every trip has been wonderful with great service all around. The hotel has a very tropical decor with lots of plants and water features. We went with the Royal Service last year for our honeymoon and its definitely worth the money! Loved the poolside Bali beds with great food (huge shrimp cocktail & awesome buffalo wings) and again awesome service. For dinner the Market Grill is a must. Also loved the passion fruit margaritas rimmed in chilli powder and sugar... just not sure which restaurant that was. It had been a good day! Everything you want so you'll never need to leave the hotel. Can't wait to go back. See you soon Paradisus

findings.title: Heather A. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Words can't do justice to describe this resort. Pictures can't show how beautiful it all is! From the moment you drive up, you immediately notice the pyramid type rooftops that make up the 5 building resort. Each 'peak' is an atrium with wonderful green vines hanging from the ceiling and jungle-like plants/scenery throughout each buildings' center. Complimentary valet parking since we had a rental car was a really nice surprise. While we were waiting in line to get checked in, someone walked up and took our drink order and delivered us 2 margaritas in no time! We upgraded to their Royal Service, which consists of an adults only pool, having our own personal butler to make dinner reservations, reserve Bali beds by the pool (where we had poolside drinks and food delivered to us from 11am to 5pm by a wonderful server named Rafael), and basically gave us anything our hearts desired during our stay. Rodè, our butler, even made a heart design with rose petals on our bed, drew us a bath with bubbles and rose petals, and gave us a complimentary bottle of champagne, all set up while we were at our private poolside cabana! We ordered room service every morning for breakfast, our mini bar was restocked daily, and all but one restaurant was included in our all inclusive package. We had our choice of sushi, Italian, Spanish, Brazilian style steakhouse, buffet, etc, so lots to choose from. Each staff member who walked by or helped us with anything were so genuinely friendly. The entire staff (especially Rodè and Rafael) and the quality of food, drinks, and ambiance, is exactly why we are looking forward to coming back soon!

findings.title: Susan R. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
While your hotel, restaurants and pool are beautiful, I could never stay here again due to the OVERWHELMING artificial sweet honey(Melia)  fragrance that assaults you as soon as you enter the hotel or leave your room.

The main hotel also has an artificial fragrance being pumped throughout, however, it is not as offensive.

You should warn guests with chemical sensitivities to the persistent perfume.  I have many allergies and this was very disturbing to my senses.

findings.title: Shauntae P. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
Let me start off by saying I hate reading long reviews but I had to write one because everything was so amazing !

Whoever gave this hotel a bad review must have been super boojie. I highly recommend this all inclusive resort. I see a lot of people saying that you get better service when you pay extra for Royal service and that's not true at all. I stayed here five days and I was treated like a queen each day. 

The hotel room was sooo nice I had a balcony with an ocean view. The housekeepers cleaned our room everyday and also came back in the afternoon for turn down service. They filled our mini refrigerator everyday ! 

Room service is 24 hours and is added in the all inclusive which was great. Room service took about 20 mins which wasn't bad at all. They have there good and tasteless food on the menu but I enjoyed most of it. Nachos, wings, Caesar salad  were very good. 

The hotel itself is BEAUTIFUL. It has plants everywhere and oddly it smells great ! And there aren't any bugs or pollen. 

The staff is amazing !! Everyone is so nice and polite ! They also keep this hotel very clean. I never seen any dirt or garbage anywhere ! The staff was constantly cleaning and constantly asking if you needed anything.

The beach and the pools are beautiful ! They have a cabana beds that you can rent in the day time but after a certain time there free so don't waste your money ! 

The bar in the pool is really cool and these men definitely know how to make a drink ! My new favorite drink is called Miami vice it was so good !
They also have staff that deliver food to you poolside which was very good. We laid by the pool and ordered wings and spring rolls which were veryyyyy good ! You never have to ask for a drink because as soon as you turn around the waiters and waitresses are already asking you if you need something.
 
I see some reviews saying how this hotel is loud and I have no idea what they're talking about because the most noise you'll get is from the pool between 12pm and 5pm and its mild they don't blast music at all and after 7pm the hotel is super quiet I was very surprised and even if you don't want to hear a lil noise once you close your balcony door you really can't hear a thing ! 

Since this place is all inclusive the tip is already included but the service was so amazing that I had to tip extra. The staff is really great. I will definitely recommend this hotel and I am definitely coming back ! 

I recommend naos which is a buffet. Everyday for breakfast, lunch and dinner there open and they had different food everyday I was surprised ! There very good. Market grill also had a different selection everyday and they were also very good. Bana which is in the middle of the hotel is soooo good ! Fuego is also delicious ! Those were my top fav restaurants.

They also have hookah for very cheap. $21 at the pool and cocos on the beach

findings.title: Carolina G. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
My sister and I spent 3 nights at this hotel and it was outstanding. Two preliminary notes, however:

1) We speak fluent Spanish, so that probably contributed to our pleasant experience with all of the staff; and
2) We didn't bring any kids, and didn't try to rent anything at the hotel (e.g., the bali beds).

We absolutely loved the food here. We ate at the buffet multiple times, and it really is great. Everything is fresh and the variety of food is immense. We also ate at Blue Agave (good) and Fuego (effing outstanding). All of the bars were efficient and gave us exactly what we ordered the first time. Very clean rooms, fast WiFi, and helpful staff willing to help you at all hours (we know that from experience). When we wanted to book an excursion, we just went to the lady that books the trips, and a few minutes later, we were done. 

The hotel itself is absolutely gorgeous. The lobby looks like a jungle. When entering the hotel at night from the street, it looks like three glittering pyramidal jewels with glowing purple peaks. The outside facing the water is also obviously very beautiful, since it is on an oceanfront. 

The probability of us coming back to this specific hotel is very high.

findings.title: Jason W. (5/5)
findings.snippet: We have come here 5 or 6 times as a family and I absolutely love it. It's such a fun hotel. The pools are awesome and the people are extremely nice and friendly!

findings.title: Mohammad M. (4/5)
findings.snippet: Cancun is a wonderful place to visit. It is worth every penny dollar. This hotel is nice but a bit overrated.  You feel very welcomed once you enter.  Last day not so much. Staff are friendly. Rooms are clean.  View was wonderful.

findings.title: Muhammad M. (4/5)
findings.snippet: we recently stayed at this hotel for the march break...based on our overall experience i will give this resort a four star rating...the biggest plus was the service...we mostly travel to usa, canada or europe...the service we got in cancun was way better than what u get in other places...non pretentious and ever present...all the staff was very helpful...our flight came in early in the morning...but they checked us in early without any extra charge....the food has lot of variety...however the food taste was compromissed...we liked the dinner at mole the best...kids loved the pool area and beach...the building and furniture need upgrading...overall i will recommend this hotel for families....

findings.title: Alina L. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
I came to vacation with my boyfriend for 4 nights. 
We like to travel and already been in many hotel before.. 
The second you enter the hotel there is a lady that try to explains you why it's so worth to join there club or something like this... (We came after 6 hours flight) we stopped her in the middle of her monolog and went to room
First we got a room that made for disable people (we are not) 
So much noise! 
My boyfriend went to take a shower and after a minute the bathroom was floated .. We asked to fix it several times until they promised that we will change the room the next day.

But the worst thing about this hotel is their Guest service!! The worst I have ever had !!!
They hardly know English, they never kind and not helpful at all! 
When I tried to make reservations for dinner The lady in the phone was very rude and didn't even let me finish my sentence!   
We paid a lot of money for all inclusive hotel but we found out its a fraud!!!  
The food is below average, the only people who can enjoy it are those who like junk food

Overall we are very disappointed, I won't recommend this hotel to anyone who wants to have a great vacation.

findings.title: Daniel G. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
The Paradisus Cancun is an amazing hotel, the service, cleanliness, food, and people are all 5 stars. From the minute you check in, to when you leave, you will have a great time. The restaurants are all amazing, the grounds are beautiful, the staff is always friendly and you can tell they will go the extra mile for you. This is my second time at this resort, and I am already planning on next year to return. Definitely definitely do the royal service upgrade, it comes with a bunch of great perks (private beach and restaurants, priority reservations) and the best part of it is the butler.
