Besides the activities, we never had a need to leave the resort. We had everything we needed there! Overall, we had an amazing experience and would totally go back and would recommend it to everyone who wants a royal affordable experience!

findings.title: Emilee E. (5/5)
findings.snippet: The food was excellent and they treated us like QUEENS! We stayed in Royal Service. David was our butler. Francisco Terrazas was our server by the pool. HE WAS AMAZING! Very attentive, so sweet, he even remembered our names. It was excellent! Salvador the bartender was sooooooo generous and also very attentive. We look forward to our next trip!

findings.title: Angela T. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
Just got back from a 4 nights stay here with my family and some of our friends and was overall pretty happy with the hotel. Lots of places to eat and drink, and it's constant with the eating. At check in we were greeted by amazing floral smells, and walked in to check out with no problems. The hotel is a bit humid since its housed in a giant pyramid with glass tips, i imagine it's to help with all the plants around the hotel. Had a room on the 6th floor with no real problems, except the a//c leaked water here and there, and there was a tiny bug problem. I just advise you no to put your clothes in the drawers. 

Room: we had a double, with beach front views, that also overlooked one of the pools and it was absolutely beautiful. Pillows were so so, kind of lumpy, but spacious. Bathrooms were nice, waterfall showers with a little hand held shower head as well. Toilets were clean, there's also a bidet if you're into that... 

Food: we mostly ate at naos which is the buffet and it's the only restaurant on site that serves breakfast and lunch besides the other little places that serves hot dogs and stuff pool side. Good amount of options that cater to americanized tourists and some authentic stuff too. Ate at the sushi restaurant bana, and was severely disappointed, small menu, and weird textured rice.. La perla the steakhouse was also ick, steak was way overcooked and thin as heck! blue agave was great though. The bars were all really great.

Service: service is top notch here, there's ALWAYS someone around to help you with anything you need, whether you're at a restaurant, pool side, lounging at the beach or around the hotel. If you need a drink, you're never too far from a bar, but there's also someone coming around to take drink orders or food orders.

Location: it's only about 15-20 minutes from the airport and is a great location in relativity to shopping and water sports aplenty across the street.

findings.title: B. S. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
Where do I begin? I was extremely disappointed from the time I arrived. The hotel is ok in terms of superficial looks. We arrived on a late flight and were pretty tired. Upon arrival the hotel was EXTREMELY hot, no air at all. We checked in and asked for an ocean view room. We were told we'd have to pay an extra $150 for the upgrade. We paid it and proceeded to our room which was in the middle of nowhere, pyramid 3.  It was in a far end of a pyramid where we had to walk for about 10 mins and could not find one person to direct where we had to go.  We ended up roaming the hotel with no air conditioning for about a half hour. We finally got to our room.  I was absolutely disgusted! Our room was dingy, musty, old and tiny.  I opened the balcony door and found a jacuzzi on the balcony, I had no care for a dirty jacuzzi with a dirt ring around it. I immediately went to the front desk as I could not imagine spending a night on that bed. Front desk rep said they didn't have anything free that night but would check in the morning. I insisted they find a room as I paid an astronomical price for my stay and the room I booked looked NOTHING like the one I saw online. After 15 mins at 12:30am we got a room in pyramid 1 with an ocean view. We proceeded to our room which was a little bit decent and looked like what I booked. The next day we ventured around the hotel hoping to get a fresh start. The grounds were nice. The view is gorgeous because the water is gorgeous. The breakfast was ok. I didn't see bacon so I asked and was told they don't put it out you have to ask for it. The outdoor seating was gross because the chairs were moldy. We went to the pool with the swim up bar, I was further disappointed because I'm not an expert swimmer and I'm 5'3" and could not find an area in the pool that was less than 5'9" I had to have my husband tow me on his back from the steps to the bar!!! Finally we get to the bar and asked for Grey Goose and cranberry, we were told they had none and it's not served there. I was shocked because the hotel advertised foreign liquor top grade. We asked for an old fashioned and was told they didn't know what that was but we were offered tequila and mojitos the entire time! I was disgusted even further. We decides to get lunch later that afternoon and decided to make reservations for that evening, we were told we need to make all our reservations in advance because there would be no room left. We were forced to pick what they had available, another disappointment.

Scattered throughout the hotel there were broken vents, random towels left in corners all around the hotel, our towels in the room were worn out and looked like pool towels. We went to the so called club one night on premises and I saw a bottle of Belvidere, better vodka than what they were serving, I asked the bartender for some with orange juice, he said he'd have to find out how much it was! By the third day my husband and I were going mad! We met three other couples who all complained about the same rotten service and dirty rooms and problems.  One couple had kids and had butler service with their plan but said they didn't 1 thing extra that they paid for. 

This was by far the biggest let down we have ever experienced! Don't let the "awesome" reviews fool you! If you're looking to drink cheap tequila in a pool that closes at 6pm with a pretty beach, then by all means go here.  But if you're the Westin, Ritz or Mandarin kind of traveler, please steer clear of this place!!! The 10 rating is a lie and should be a 1!!! 

Will NOT BE STAYING HERE AGAIN OR REFERRING FRIENDS AT ALL!
I wrote to the hotel manager and have not heard back yet!  Very very upsetting!

findings.title: Susie M. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
I completely second the review by Angel. This place is amazing. The service is beyond anything I have experienced elsewhere. We stayed in Royal Service, and it was worth every penny. We were greeted by Melissa who gave us a tour and answered some questions. She even had a bottle of my husbands favorite liquor sent up to our room to say welcome. We were then introduced us to Galdino our butler for the week. He was kind and available but never overbearing. He made our dinner reservations, gave us useful tips about the resort and other local attractions, and was available by a cell phone provided by the resort if we needed anything at all.....which, with such amazing service we did not ever need a thing!!!

The pools were sparkling, the beaches soft sand with turquoise waters, amazing views of the sunrise and the sunsets, golf course, plenty of bars with delicious drinks and lounge beds were plenty. There was never an issue with finding a lounge chair by the pool or on the beach. They have classes each day such as massage techniques or how to make ceviche. They also offered Zumba and soccer, and we even saw some children's art and cooking classes as well. Royal Service has their own set of amenities, which included a separate pool, special snack area, private check in lounge, a self-service bar area, La Palapa which is a restaurant just for RS guests, and so much more.

The restaurants are out of this world, but Vento was by far our favorite. Leo was our server and he made some amazing recommendations, and was willing to get anything we needed our entire meal. He was lovely. Later in the week we ate at Market Grill which was a churascaria style meal, and we had amazing service there as well.

Our only disappointment for the entire week were the shows. They are fun, funny, energetic and entertaining. The problem is that the talent exceeds the stage. There is only a small viewing area in one of the larger bars, and it is hard to get a good view, and even when you do the lighting for the performers is right above you, making it unbearably hot. Sadly, we only saw a few minutes of a couple of shows because of this. Wish we could have stayed longer. These performers deserve a better stage, like I said it was a good show.

Overall, this place was amazing!!! We have only been home for three days and we are already talking about going back.

findings.title: Angel L. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
Amazing! I can't even come up with words to truly express how much I loved my vacation here. We were here during the second week of April with 28 other people for my wedding. We had an awesome time! It was honestly just a great experience. All the staff was so sweet, responsive and caring. Everyone goes out of their way for you! Pools are beautiful. Beach is beautiful. Great for kids. Drinks are great and food is also good. I don't have one complaint. 

If you are thinking about doing a destination wedding this is the place to do it! We had an amazing time. 

The only part that sucked was actually having to leave! Wish we were still there.
